Lift your shoulders up and roll them back in a large circle.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Do 10 circles, then reverse the direction.

name: وصول بذراع واحدة مع دحرجة ورفع على الركبتين
englishName: kneeling one arm reach roll lift
description: A kneeling drill where one arm reaches, rolls and lifts to open the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Reach one arm forward along the floor.
Roll that arm up and across, rotating your chest.
Lift it toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Return and repeat, then switch arms.

name: عقلة L
description: A pull-up with the legs held out straight in an L shape. It trains the lats, biceps and core.
instructions: أمسك بار العقلة بقبضة علوية أوسع قليلاً من عرض الكتفين.
تعلق مع فرد ذراعيك بالكامل واستقامة جسمك.
شد عضلات الظهر الجانبية والبايسبس لسحب جسمك نحو البار مع إبقاء مرفقيك قريبين من جسمك.
استمر في السحب حتى يصبح ذقنك فوق البار.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أنزل جسمك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: إل سيت على الأرض
description: A seated hold on the floor, hands beside the hips, with the legs lifted straight out. It trains the abs, hip flexors and triceps.
instructions: اجلس على الأرض مع مد ساقيك أمامك.
ضع يديك على الأرض بجانب وركيك مع توجيه أصابعك إلى الأمام.
شد عضلات جذعك وارفع ساقيك عن الأرض مع إبقائهما مستقيمتين.
حاول جعل ساقيك موازيتين للأرض مع تشكيل شكل حرف L مع جسمك.
حافظ على هذه الوضعية لأطول فترة ممكنة.
أنزل ساقيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: في سيت على الأرض
description: A seated hold with both the legs and the upper body lifted into a V shape. It trains the abs, hip flexors and balance.
instructions: اجلس على الأرض مع مد ساقيك أمامك.
انحنِ إلى الخلف قليلاً وارفع ساقيك عن الأرض مع إبقائهما مستقيمتين.
في الوقت نفسه، ارفع الجزء العلوي من جسمك عن الأرض ومد ذراعيك نحو ساقيك.
حافظ على هذه الوضعية لبضع ثوانٍ ثم أنزل الجزء العلوي من جسمك وساقيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: كيك باك جالس بالدمبل
description: Seated and bent forward, you straighten your arms behind you with dumbbells. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: اجلس على مقعد مع وضع قدميك على الأرض وأمسك دمبل في كل يد.
اثنِ ركبتيك قليلاً وانحنِ إلى الأمام من وركيك مع الحفاظ على استقامة ظهرك.
قرّب ذراعيك العلويين من جانبيك وحافظ على ثني مرفقيك بزاوية 90 درجة.
مد ذراعيك إلى الخلف مع الضغط على الترايسبس في أعلى الحركة.
توقف لحظة، ثم أنزل الدمبلين ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: كرنش بالكرة الطبية
description: A crunch holding a medicine ball to add resistance for the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a medicine ball on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.
Breathe out as you crunch up.

name: كرنش بالكرة الطبية
description: A crunch holding a medicine ball to add resistance for the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a medicine ball on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.
Breathe out as you crunch up.

name: فلاي بالدمبل بوضعية عالية
description: A flat-bench dumbbell fly done with a wide arc and a stretch across the chest. It isolates the pecs.
instructions: استلقِ على مقعد مسطح مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد مع توجيه راحتي يديك نحو بعضهما.
مد ذراعيك فوق صدرك مع ثني بسيط في مرفقيك.
مع إبقاء ثني بسيط في مرفقيك، أنزل الدمبلين إلى الجانبين بقوس واسع حتى تشعر بتمدد في صدرك.
توقف لحظة، ثم اعكس الحركة وأعد الدمبلين إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: ضغط المطرقة بالدمبل من الاستلقاء على الأرض
englishName: dumbbell lying on floor hammer press
description: A floor press with palms facing each other, which is kind to your shoulders. It trains the chest and triceps through a short range.
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.

name: ضغط سفند بوزن إضافي
description: A chest squeeze press holding a plate between the palms and pushing it forward. It trains the inner chest and shoulders.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين وأمسك قرص وزن أمام صدرك بكلتا يديك.
حافظ على ثني مرفقيك قليلاً وتوجيه راحتي يديك نحو بعضهما.
ادفع قرص الوزن أمامك مع مد ذراعيك بالكامل.
توقف لحظة في نهاية الحركة ثم قرّب قرص الوزن ببطء عائداً إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: جسر الألوية بالدمبل
description: A loaded hip bridge that targets your glutes. Resting a dumbbell on your hips adds resistance.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

name: رفع أمامي بالدمبل v. 3
description: Lift dumbbells in front of you to work the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the weights in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

name: رفع الكتف الخلفي بالدمبل
description: A bent-over dumbbell raise to the sides. Trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين وأمسك دمبل في كل يد مع توجيه راحتي يديك نحو جسمك.
اثنِ ركبتيك قليلاً وانحنِ للأمام عند الوركين مع الحفاظ على استقامة ظهرك.
ارفع ذراعيك إلى الجانبين مع ثني بسيط في مرفقيك حتى تصبحا موازيتين للأرض.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أنزل ذراعيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: سكوت برس بالدمبل
description: A seated dumbbell press from shoulder height. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: اجلس على مقعد مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد وتوجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأمام.
ارفع الدمبلين إلى مستوى الكتفين مع ثني مرفقيك وتوجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأمام.
ادفع الدمبلين إلى الأعلى حتى تمتد ذراعاك بالكامل.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أنزل الدمبلين ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: سحب عمودي بالدمبل
description: Standing, you pull dumbbells up along your body toward chin height. It builds the side shoulders and upper traps.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد بقبضة علوية.
اترك الدمبلين يتدليان أمام فخذيك مع مد ذراعيك بالكامل.
مع الحفاظ على استقامة ظهرك وشد عضلات جذعك، أخرج الزفير وارفع الدمبلين نحو ذقنك مع قيادة الحركة بمرفقيك.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم خذ شهيقاً وأنزل الدمبلين ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: ضغط دبليو بالدمبل
description: You press dumbbells overhead in a W-shaped path. It trains the shoulders and the muscles that stabilise them.
instructions: اجلس على مقعد مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد وتوجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأمام.
ارفع الدمبلين إلى مستوى الكتفين مع ثني مرفقيك وتوجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأمام.
ادفع الدمبلين إلى الأعلى حتى تمد ذراعيك بالكامل فوق رأسك.
أنزل الدمبلين عائدين إلى مستوى الكتفين.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: ركلات السباح v. 2 (ذكر)
description: A face-down flutter kick, lifting the chest and legs off the floor and kicking in a swimming motion. It trains the glutes and lower back.
instructions: استلقِ على بطنك على بساط مع مد ذراعيك فوق رأسك.
شد عضلات جذعك وارفع صدرك وساقيك عن الأرض في الوقت نفسه.
حرك ساقيك إلى الأعلى والأسفل بحركة رفرفة كما لو كنت تسبح.
استمر في الركل للعدد المطلوب.
أنزل صدرك وساقيك عائدين إلى وضع البداية.

name: ركلات السباح v. 2 (ذكر)
description: A face-down flutter kick, lifting the chest and legs off the floor and kicking in a swimming motion. It trains the glutes and lower back.
instructions: استلقِ على بطنك على بساط مع مد ذراعيك فوق رأسك.
شد عضلات جذعك وارفع صدرك وساقيك عن الأرض في الوقت نفسه.
حرك ساقيك إلى الأعلى والأسفل بحركة رفرفة كما لو كنت تسبح.
استمر في الركل للعدد المطلوب.
أنزل صدرك وساقيك عائدين إلى وضع البداية.

name: جسر الورك بساق واحدة (ساق مستقيمة)
description: A one-leg hip bridge with the other leg held straight, strongly working glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Lower with control.
Switch legs after your set.

name: سوبرمان
description: A floor extension that lifts arms and legs to strengthen the lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back.
Hold for 1-2 seconds.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

name: ضغط زحف العنكبوت
description: A push-up combined with a knee drive toward the elbow, like a crawling spider. It trains the chest, core and hips together.
instructions: ابدأ بوضعية تمرين الضغط مع مباعدة يديك بمسافة أوسع قليلاً من عرض الكتفين وضم قدميك معاً.
قرّب ركبتك اليمنى نحو مرفقك الأيمن مع إبقائها عن الأرض.
أثناء إعادة ركبتك اليمنى للخلف، أنزل جسمك نحو الأرض في الوقت نفسه عن طريق ثني مرفقيك.
ادفع عائداً إلى وضع البداية وكرر الحركة مع ركبتك اليسرى نحو مرفقك الأيسر.
استمر في التبديل بين الجانبين للعدد المطلوب.

name: رفع الورك والساق مائل للأسفل
description: A leg raise on a decline bench, finishing with a hip lift for the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge.
Bring your legs up over your hips.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips first.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid swinging.

name: رمي الكرة الطبية للخلف
description: An explosive overhead throw behind you that trains the hips and posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with a medicine ball held between your legs.
Squat slightly, then explode up.
Swing the ball up and back over your head.
Release it behind you at full extension.
Retrieve the ball.
Reset your stance and repeat.

name: قفز منفرج إلى الصندوق
description: A jump from a split stance onto a box, building leg power.
instructions: Stand in a lunge position facing a box.
Swing your arms and jump up.
Land with both feet softly on the box.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Switch your front leg and repeat.

name: ثني وتمديد الرقبة جالساً
description: A seated neck mobility drill moving the head forward and back.
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lower your chin gently toward your chest.
Hold for a moment.
Slowly lift your head and look up slightly.
Move through a comfortable range only.
Repeat 8-10 times smoothly.

name: رمي الكرة الطبية فوق الرأس واقفاً
description: An explosive overhead throw with a medicine ball, working the upper body and trunk.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding the ball overhead.
Arch back slightly.
Throw the ball forward and down with force.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball.
Reset and repeat.

name: غطس على الأرض بالكرسي
description: A seated dip with your hands on a chair behind you.
instructions: Sit on the floor with hands on a chair behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Keep elbows pointing back.
Press up.
Brace the chair against a wall.

name: صعود على الكرسي
description: A step-up onto a sturdy chair, a simple single-leg exercise.
instructions: Face a sturdy chair.
Place one foot fully on the seat.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Do all reps on one leg, then switch.

name: سوينغ بالدمبل
description: A hip driven swing using a dumbbell, building power in your glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold one dumbbell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let your arms stay relaxed.
Guide it back down and hinge into the next rep.

name: في أب بالدمبل
description: A v up while holding a dumbbell, raising your arms and legs together to challenge the abs.
instructions: Lie flat with legs straight and a dumbbell held in both hands overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your arms and legs together, forming a V shape.
Touch the dumbbell near your shins.
Lower back down slowly without dropping your legs.

name: اندفاع جانبي بالدمبل v. 3
description: A side lunge with dumbbells that works the thighs and inner thighs.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return to center.
Alternate sides.

name: اندفاع جانبي بالدمبل v. 3
description: A side lunge with dumbbells that works the thighs and inner thighs.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return to center.
Alternate sides.

name: لف روسي بالدمبل
description: A seated rotation with a dumbbell for the obliques.
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted.
Move with control.

name: لف روسي بالدمبل
description: A seated rotation with a dumbbell for the obliques.
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted.
Move with control.

name: بنش برس عكسي بالدمبل
description: A bench press with a reverse grip using dumbbells. It targets the upper chest and the triceps.
instructions: استلقِ على مقعد مسطح مع وضع قدميك على الأرض وثني ركبتيك.
أمسك دمبل في كل يد بقبضة علوية مع توجيه راحتي يديك نحو قدميك.
مد ذراعيك نحو السقف مع ثني بسيط في مرفقيك.
أنزل الدمبلين ببطء نحو صدرك مع انفراج مرفقيك إلى الجانبين.
توقف لحظة في أسفل الحركة، ثم ادفع الدمبلين عائدين إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: ضغط سفند بالدمبل
description: A plate-style squeeze press using a dumbbell held between your palms.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell upright between your palms.
Hold it at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together.
Press the weight straight out.
Return to your chest.
Keep the squeeze all the time.

name: ضغط سفند بالدمبل
description: A plate-style squeeze press using a dumbbell held between your palms.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell upright between your palms.
Hold it at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together.
Press the weight straight out.
Return to your chest.
Keep the squeeze all the time.

name: سوبرمان بالدمبل
description: A loaded superman hold with dumbbells for the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down holding light dumbbells with arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

name: سوبرمان بالدمبل
description: A loaded superman hold with dumbbells for the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down holding light dumbbells with arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

name: بيربي مع ضغط
description: A burpee that includes a full push-up for conditioning.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up.
Jump your feet in and leap up.
Repeat at a steady pace.

name: بيربي مع ضغط
description: A burpee that includes a full push-up for conditioning.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up.
Jump your feet in and leap up.
Repeat at a steady pace.

name: سبليت جانبي
description: A wide-leg stretch for the inner thighs and groin.
instructions: Sit or stand with your legs as wide as comfortable.
Keep your toes pointing up or forward.
Lower slowly into the split.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come out gently.

name: نبضات للأعلى
description: Small upward pulses with your legs raised, targeting the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs pointing to the ceiling.
Place your hands by your sides.
Lift your hips slightly with a small pulse.
Lower and repeat.
Keep movement small.
Do 15-20 pulses.

name: تقريب الورك في بلانك جانبي (ركبة مثنية)
description: A side plank with the top leg lifting inward, working the inner thighs and obliques.
instructions: Set up in a side plank with the bottom knee bent.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your hips.
Raise the bottom leg toward the top leg.
Lower with control.
Switch sides.

name: إحماء بالاندفاع (واحد)
description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 1 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

name: إحماء بالاندفاع (اثنان)
description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 2 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 3 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.

Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.

Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.

Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.

Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

name: إحماء بالاندفاع (سبعة)
description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 7 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

name: تمدد الفخذ الخلفي الأمامي
description: A simple stretch for the back of the thigh.
instructions: Place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Feel the stretch behind your thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

name: وضعية الكلب المقلوب
description: A classic yoga pose that stretches the back of the legs and shoulders.
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower down gently.

name: اندفاع أمامي (ذكر)
description: A bodyweight lunge stepping forward and pushing back, alternating legs. It builds the glutes, quads and balance.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الوركين ووضع يديك على وركيك.
تقدم خطوة كبيرة إلى الأمام بقدمك اليمنى مع إنزال جسمك إلى وضع اللانج.
اثنِ ركبتك اليمنى حوالي 90 درجة مع إبقاء ركبتك محاذية لكاحلك.
ادفع بقدمك اليمنى وعد إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة مع ساقك اليسرى مع التبديل بين الجانبين للعدد المطلوب.

name: وضعية المحارب
description: A standing yoga pose that builds strength and stretches the hips.
instructions: Take a long stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Raise your arms.
Keep your back leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

name: تمدد الورك بطي الساق من الاستلقاء
description: A lying hip stretch pulling the knee in toward the chest.
instructions: Lie on your back.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your other leg relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

name: تمدد الورك الخارجي واقفاً بتوازن
description: A standing stretch for the outer hip that also challenges balance.
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit back slightly.
Feel the stretch in your outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

name: تمدد الورك بطي الساق من الاستلقاء ويدان فوق الرأس
englishName: lying leg tuck hip stretch with overhead hands
description: A lying knee-tuck stretch with arms extended overhead for a longer line.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your arms reaching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

name: تمدد الورك والظهر بطي الساق من الاستلقاء
englishName: lying leg tuck hip back stretch
description: A lying tuck stretch easing the hips and lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back.
Hug both knees toward your chest.
Rock gently if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax your shoulders.
Release slowly.

name: تمدد الورك بطي الساق مع لف من الاستلقاء
englishName: lying leg tuck hip twist stretch
description: A lying stretch with a spinal twist to open the hips and back.
instructions: Lie on your back and pull your knees in.
Drop both knees to one side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the center.
Switch sides.

name: تمدد الورك بطي الساق نحو اليمين من الاستلقاء
englishName: lying leg tuck hip back to right stretch
description: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the right.
instructions: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the right.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

name: تمدد الورك بطي الساق مع لف نحو اليسار من الاستلقاء
englishName: lying leg tuck hip twist to left stretch
description: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the left.
instructions: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the left.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

name: سكوات مع لمس الكعب بالتناوب وركلة جانبية
englishName: alternate heel touch side kick squat
description: A squat that adds a side kick and a heel touch for legs and coordination.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Squat down.
Stand and kick one leg to the side.
Touch the heel with your hand.
Squat again.
Alternate sides.

name: اندفاع العداء بالتناوب
description: A lunge with a sprint-style arm drive and alternating legs.
instructions: Stand tall.
Step back into a deep lunge.
Drive your arms like a sprinter.
Push back to standing.
Alternate legs.
Keep your torso upright.

name: اندفاع العداء المنفرج المنخفض
description: A low lunge hold in a sprinter stance for the legs and hips.
instructions: Step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Hold the low position briefly.
Push up.
Switch legs.

name: اندفاع العداء المنفرج العالي
description: A high lunge with the arms driving like a sprinter's. It builds leg strength, balance and hip stability.
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot well back into a staggered stance.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, back heel lifted.
Swing the arm opposite the front leg forward and the other arm back, like sprinting.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to rise, then repeat all reps.
Switch legs and do the same number.

name: ثبات سوبرمان حول العالم
description: A face-down superman hold with the arms sweeping in a circle. It strengthens the glutes, lower back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and down toward your hips in a wide arc.
Sweep them back overhead along the same path.
Keep your neck neutral and legs lifted throughout.
Lower down with control after your set.

name: جلوس من الاستلقاء مع المرفق نحو الركبة
description: A sit-up that finishes by driving one elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and rotate your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your back to the floor with control.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

name: تجديف مقلوب بركبة مثنية بين الكراسي
englishName: inverted row with bent knee between chairs
description: A home row where you hang under a bar or broom handle set across two chairs, knees bent to make it easier. It trains the back and biceps.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar overhand, arms straight, knees bent and feet flat.
Keep your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest up toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

name: كيرل ذقن مقلوب بركبة مثنية بين الكراسي
englishName: inverted chin curl with bent knee between chairs
description: An underhand-grip hang under a bar between two chairs, curling your body up with the biceps. Bent knees keep it manageable.
instructions: Place a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar underhand, arms straight, knees bent.
Keep your hips up and body in a line.
Curl yourself up by bending the elbows, keeping them close.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.
Check the chairs are stable before each set.

name: عقلة بركبة مثنية بين الكراسي
englishName: pull up with bent knee between chairs
description: A beginner-friendly pull-up built from a bar across two chairs, with the feet on the floor and knees bent. It builds lats and arm pulling strength.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs, high enough to sit under.
Sit or lie beneath it and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your knees bent with feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Use your legs as little as you can.

name: ضغط كوبرا
description: A push-up that flows into a cobra-style chest opening at the top. It trains the chest and arms and works the back and spine.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows tucked.
Press up and keep going, letting your hips sink forward.
Lift your chest and look slightly up, like a cobra.
Return to the plank by lifting your hips back.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.

name: ضغط كوبرا على الركبتين
description: A kneeling version of the cobra push-up that is easier on the arms and core. It works the chest and gently extends the spine.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands under your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows close.
Press up and let your hips sink forward, lifting your chest into a cobra.
Shift your hips back to the start.
Repeat smoothly.

name: ضغط على الركبتين مائل للأسفل على الصندوق
englishName: decline kneeling push up on box
description: A kneeling push-up with the hands on a box, so the body slopes downward. It's an easier push-up that still stresses the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place a sturdy box in front of you and kneel on the floor.
Put your hands on the box edge, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the box with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

name: ضغط مائل للأسفل على الحائط
description: A push-up with the feet up the wall and hands on the floor. The raised feet put more load on the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place your hands on the floor and walk your feet up a wall behind you.
Set your hands under your shoulders in a straight body line.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows tucked.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Walk your feet down to finish.

name: ضغط دوراني على الركبتين
description: A kneeling push-up that ends with a rotation and one arm reaching up. It trains the chest and trunk control.
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press up and rotate your torso, lifting one arm toward the ceiling.
Look at your raised hand for a moment.
Bring the hand back down and lower for the next rep.
Alternate sides each rep.

name: سكوات بساق واحدة على صندوق منخفض
description: A one-leg squat down to a low box, giving you a target depth. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand in front of a low box or bench on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward and raise your arms for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: سكوات بساق واحدة مع لمس الكعب
description: A single-leg squat where you reach down to touch the heel of the working foot. It challenges balance and leg strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other foot slightly off the floor.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee to squat down.
Reach down toward the heel of your standing foot.
Keep your chest as tall as you can.
Push through your foot to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

name: تجديف من الاستلقاء على الأرض بركبة مثنية
englishName: lying floor row with bent knee
description: A row done lying on the floor, pulling against an anchored handle or towel, with knees bent. It works the back and biceps with no equipment.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a secure anchor, such as a towel around a sturdy post, with arms straight.
Pull your body toward your hands by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your hips on or near the floor.

name: مسيرة بساقين مستقيمتين من الاستلقاء
description: Alternating straight-leg raises while lying on your back, like a slow march. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back, arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Raise one straight leg toward the ceiling.
Lower it as you raise the other leg.
Keep alternating in a slow, steady march.
Keep your back from arching.

name: سحب بالانزلاق على الأرض بمنشفة
description: Slide your hands along the floor on a towel, from overhead down toward your sides. It teaches a pulldown pattern for the lats.
instructions: Kneel or lie face down with your hands on towels on a smooth floor.
Start with your arms extended overhead.
Press down and pull your arms back toward your hips, sliding the towels.
Squeeze your lats at the end.
Slide the hands back overhead with control.
Keep your core braced.

name: جسر وكيرل بالانزلاق على الأرض بمنشفة
englishName: sliding floor bridge curl on towel
description: A glute bridge with the heels on towels, sliding the feet in and out. It strongly works the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Lower your hips to finish the set.

name: بول أوفر مقلوب بمساعدة ذاتية
description: A pullover-style move hanging under a bar, with the legs helping a bit. It builds the lats and shoulder strength.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar at hip height or lower and hang beneath it with an overhand grip.
Keep your feet on the floor to help as needed.
Pull your chest toward the bar and let your hips rise.
Continue to rotate your torso up and over the bar toward your hands, as your range allows.
Reverse slowly back to the start.
Use your legs only as needed.

name: تمرين مرونة السكوات الكامل
description: A deep squat hold with gentle movement to open the hips, ankles and lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows against your inner knees with hands together.
Shift gently side to side and hold the bottom.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand up slowly.

name: بلانك أمامي مع رفع الساق
description: A forearm plank with alternating leg lifts. It builds core stability and glute strength.
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one leg a few inches without rotating your hips.
Lower it and lift the other leg.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

name: أرجحة الساق للأمام والخلف
description: A dynamic warm-up swinging one leg forward and back. It loosens the hips and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall beside a wall or support and hold it for balance.
Shift your weight onto the inside leg.
Swing the outside leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
Keep your torso upright.
Increase the range gradually.
Switch legs after your reps.

name: كرنش بلانك جانبي بالمرفق نحو الركبة
englishName: elbow to knee side plank crunch
description: A side plank where you crunch the top elbow toward the knee. It targets the obliques and core.
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your hips so your body is in line.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in a crunch.
Extend back to the side plank.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: تمدد الفخذ الأمامي واقفاً بتوازن
description: A standing quad stretch with balance. It lengthens the front of the thigh and hips.
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes with knees together.
Keep your hips tucked and your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

name: وضعية الجمل
description: A kneeling backbend that opens the chest, abs and front of the hips.
instructions: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Lean back and reach for your heels if comfortable.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing evenly.
Come up slowly, leading with your chest.

name: تجديف بوزن الجسم عند مدخل الباب
description: A row done by holding both sides of a doorframe and leaning back. It trains the back and arms.
instructions: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame firmly.
Lean back with arms straight and feet close to the frame.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the frame, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
Use a sturdy frame and a non-slip grip.

name: ليج كيرل معكوس بمساعدة ذاتية v. 2
englishName: self assisted inverse leg curl v. 2
description: A bodyweight Nordic-style leg curl where you lower yourself and use your hands to help back up. It builds strong hamstrings.
instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something stable.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your torso forward slowly, using your hamstrings to resist.
Catch yourself with your hands near the floor.
Push off lightly and use your hamstrings to return.
Keep your hips extended.

name: ليج كيرل بساق واحدة جالساً بحبل المقاومة
englishName: resistance band seated single leg curl
description: A seated leg curl with a band around the foot. It isolates the hamstrings.
instructions: Sit on the floor with a band anchored in front and looped around one foot.
Extend your leg with a slight tension on the band.
Curl your heel toward your glutes, pulling against the band.
Squeeze the hamstring briefly.
Return with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

name: رفع الساقين للداخل والخارج جالساً على الأرض
englishName: seated in out leg raise on floor
description: A seated leg tuck, with legs pulled in then extended out. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the floor, hands behind you for support.
Lean back slightly with legs extended and lifted.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and your core tight.
Breathe steadily.

name: كرنشي فروج على الأرض
description: A floor ab move where knees and arms come together in a frog-like crunch. It works the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your knees in while reaching your hands toward your shins.
Squeeze your abs.
Extend back out without resting on the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

name: بيرد دوج بحبل المقاومة
description: A bird dog with a band for extra resistance, training the lower back, glutes and core stability.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a band looped under one hand and around the opposite foot.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend that arm forward and the opposite leg back against the band.
Pause, then return under control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

name: ديد باج للجزء العلوي بحبل المقاومة
englishName: resistance band upper body dead bug
description: A dead bug with a band held in the hands, pulling it as the arms move. It builds core stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips, holding a band in both hands above your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Pull one hand overhead while stretching the band.
Bring it back and alternate.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Move slowly.

name: تمدد الكتف خلف الظهر بحبل المقاومة
englishName: resistance band shoulder stretch behind the back
description: A shoulder and chest stretch holding a band behind the back. It opens the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall holding a band behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and your hands wide.
Lift your hands away from your back gently.
Keep your chest open and your ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

name: جسر وكيرل بساق واحدة بالانزلاق على الأرض بمنشفة
englishName: single leg sliding floor bridge curl on towel
description: A one-leg bridge curl with the heel on a towel. It's a tougher hamstring and glute exercise.
instructions: Lie on your back with one heel on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift the other leg straight up.
Raise your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heel away until the leg is nearly straight.
Pull the heel back toward your glutes.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

name: في أب جانبي على الأرض
description: A side-lying V-up that targets the obliques.
instructions: Lie on one side with legs together and an arm extended overhead.
Lift your legs and upper body at the same time.
Reach your top hand toward your feet.
Lower with control, not resting.
Keep your movement smooth.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

name: تمدد الكتف بالتقوس للخلف
description: A gentle backbend stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Lift your arms up behind you and open your chest.
Tilt back slightly if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

name: تمدد العمود الفقري بالتقوس للخلف
description: A gentle backbend that stretches the spine, hips and abs.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Lean back gently, lifting your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright slowly.

name: تمديد الساق جالساً بالحبل المطاطي
description: A seated leg extension with a loop band around the ankle. It isolates the quadriceps.
instructions: Sit on a chair with a band anchored behind and looped around one ankle.
Start with your knee bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your leg until it is straight.
Squeeze the quad at the top.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

name: تمديد الساق جالساً بالحبل المطاطي
description: A seated leg extension with a loop band around the ankle. It isolates the quadriceps.
instructions: Sit on a chair with a band anchored behind and looped around one ankle.
Start with your knee bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your leg until it is straight.
Squeeze the quad at the top.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

name: تجديف مقلوب بين الكراسي
description: A bodyweight row under a sturdy support between two chairs for the upper back and arms.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

name: سكوات بالدمبل على ساق واحدة
description: You squat down on one leg while holding a dumbbell, then stand up. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد.
مد ساقاً واحدة إلى الأمام وأبقها عن الأرض طوال الحركة.
اثنِ ساقك الواقفة وأنزل جسمك كما لو كنت تجلس على كرسي.
حافظ على رفع صدرك واستقامة ظهرك.
توقف لحظة في أسفل الحركة، ثم ادفع عبر كعبك للعودة إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب ثم بدّل الساقين.

name: جسر الألوية بساق واحدة وبول أوفر بالكيتل بيل
englishName: kettlebell single leg glute bridge pullover
description: A one-leg glute bridge with a kettlebell pullover, working glutes and lats.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat, other leg raised.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the kettlebell back overhead in an arc.
Bring it back up as you hold the bridge.
Lower your hips, then switch legs.

name: جسر الألوية بالساقين على المقعد (ذكر)
englishName: glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
description: A bodyweight glute bridge with the shoulders on a bench and both feet on the floor. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: اجلس على حافة مقعد مع إسناد ظهرك عليه ووضع قدميك على الأرض.
ضع يديك على المقعد بجانب وركيك للدعم.
شد عضلات المؤخرة وأوتار الركبة ثم ارفع وركيك عن المقعد حتى يشكل جسمك خطاً مستقيماً من ركبتيك إلى كتفيك.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أنزل وركيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: ضغط بالوف أفقي مع سكوات بحبل المقاومة
englishName: band horizontal pallof press with resistance band squat
description: A squat combined with a Pallof press. It builds leg strength with anti-rotation core work.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on, holding it at your chest.
Squat down, keeping your torso tall.
Stand and press the band straight out in front.
Resist the band trying to rotate you.
Bring your hands back to your chest.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: ضغط الكتف بذراع واحدة على الركبتين بجهاز لاندماين
englishName: landmine kneeling one arm shoulder press
description: A kneeling single-arm press with a landmine. It trains the shoulders and builds core stability.
instructions: Kneel facing the end of a landmine barbell.
Hold the end at shoulder height with one hand.
Keep your core tight and torso upright.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

name: مرونة العمود الفقري الصدري على الركبتين
description: A kneeling rotation drill for upper back mobility.
instructions: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow toward the opposite arm.
Open up and rotate toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

name: وضعية الكلب المقلوب مع لمس أصابع القدم
description: A downward dog with alternating hand-to-toe taps. It stretches the hamstrings and calves.
instructions: Start in a downward facing dog, hips high.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Reach one hand back to touch the opposite foot.
Return the hand and switch sides.
Keep your hips high.
Move slowly with steady breathing.

name: وضعية الكلب المقلوب لمرونة العمود الفقري
description: A downward dog flowing with gentle spine movement. It loosens the back and hamstrings.
instructions: Start in a downward facing dog.
Bend one knee, then the other, pedaling gently.
Shift your hips side to side.
Let your spine twist a little.
Keep your hands pressed into the floor.
Breathe slowly.

name: وقوف بركبة عالية بجهاز لاندماين
description: A landmine move combining a stand-up with a high knee drive. It trains the legs and core.
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest.
Stand from a squat, driving through your legs.
Raise one knee high as you stand.
Lower the foot and squat again.
Keep the barbell close to your chest.
Alternate legs each rep.

name: سكوات بالبار مع حبل مطاطي
description: A barbell squat with bands attached to increase tension at the top.
instructions: Set the bands on the rack and barbell.
Rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels.
Brace your core throughout.

name: لكمات بالتناوب
description: Alternating punches at a steady pace to raise the heart rate.
instructions: Stand with a staggered stance and fists up.
Punch forward with one arm, rotating your torso slightly.
Pull it back as you punch with the other.
Keep your core tight.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

name: خطوات الملاكم الجانبية
description: A light-footed shuffle used by boxers to keep the heart rate up.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Shift your weight from foot to foot.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hands up like a guard.
Keep it light and quick for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

name: الفخذ الأمامي
description: A bodyweight squat variation focused on the front of the thighs. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين.
أنزل جسمك عن طريق ثني ركبتيك ودفع وركيك إلى الخلف كما لو كنت تجلس على كرسي.
حافظ على رفع صدرك واستقامة ظهرك.
انزل حتى يصبح فخذاك موازيين للأرض.
ادفع عبر كعبيك للعودة إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: رفع السمانة نبضات واقفاً بوزن الجسم
description: A standing calf raise with small pulses at the top. It builds calf endurance.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a support for balance.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pulse up and down in small movements.
Keep your knees straight.
Lower fully when you finish.
Keep the movement controlled.

name: سكوات نبضات بوزن الجسم
description: A squat held at the bottom with small pulses. It burns the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until thighs are parallel.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Keep your weight on your heels.
Stand up fully to finish.

name: تجديف مقلوب مرتفع بين 3 كراسي
description: A harder inverted row with the feet elevated on a third chair. It builds the back and arms.
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs and place a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it overhand.
Put your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

name: تجديف مقلوب مرتفع بقبضة سفلية بين 3 كراسي
englishName: elevated inverted underhand grip row between 3 chairs
description: An inverted row with an underhand grip and elevated feet. It emphasises the lats and biceps.
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs and a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it underhand.
Place your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar with elbows close.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body straight.

name: تجديف مقلوب بقبضة سفلية بين الكراسي
englishName: inverted underhand grip row between chairs
description: An inverted row with an underhand grip on a bar between two chairs.
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs.
Lie under it and grip underhand.
Keep your legs straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a line.

name: تمدد مرونة العمود الفقري الصدري من الاستلقاء
description: A lying rotation stretch for the upper back.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms in front.
Lift your top arm and open it toward the other side.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the start.
Switch sides.

name: تمدد مرونة العمود الفقري الصدري على الركبتين
description: A kneeling thoracic rotation stretch.
instructions: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to start.
Switch sides.

name: رفع Y مائل للأعلى بالدمبل
description: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the lower traps and upper back.
instructions: اضبط المقعد المائل بزاوية 45 درجة واجلس عليه مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد وتوجيه راحتي يديك إلى الداخل.
انحنِ إلى الأمام قليلاً واترك ذراعيك تتدليان مع إبقاء ثني بسيط في مرفقيك.
ارفع ذراعيك إلى الجانبين وإلى الأعلى حتى تصبحا موازيتين للأرض.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أنزل ذراعيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: رفع T مائل للأعلى بالدمبل
description: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a T shape. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: اضبط المقعد المائل بزاوية 45 درجة واجلس عليه مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد وتوجيه راحتي يديك إلى الداخل.
انحنِ إلى الأمام واترك ذراعيك تتدليان عموديتين على الأرض.
مع إبقاء ذراعيك مستقيمتين، ارفعهما إلى الجانبين حتى تصبحا موازيتين للأرض.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أنزل ذراعيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: سكوات مع قفزة نزول بوزن الجسم
description: A squat that ends with an explosive jump, bringing the feet together in the air. It builds leg power and cardio.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين.
أنزل جسمك إلى وضعية السكوات عن طريق ثني ركبتيك ودفع وركيك إلى الخلف.
اقفز بقوة إلى الأعلى مع مد وركيك وركبتيك وكاحليك.
أثناء وجودك في الهواء، ضم قدميك معاً بسرعة.
اهبط بنعومة على باطن قدميك وانزل فوراً عائداً إلى وضعية السكوات.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: بلانك جانبي مائل بوزن الجسم
description: A side plank held on an incline, resting on the forearm with the body in a straight line. It trains the obliques and core.
instructions: ابدأ بالاستلقاء على جانبك مع مد ساقيك وتراكبهما فوق بعضهما.
ضع ساعدك على الأرض تحت كتفك مباشرة مع ثني مرفقك بزاوية 90 درجة.
شد عضلات جذعك وارفع وركيك عن الأرض مع تشكيل خط مستقيم من رأسك إلى قدميك.
حافظ على هذه الوضعية للمدة المطلوبة.
أنزل وركيك عائدين إلى الأرض وكرر الحركة على الجانب الآخر.

name: ضغط مائل للأعلى بالتناوب بالدمبل
description: A dumbbell press on an incline bench, with the arms alternating. It trains the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: اجلس على مقعد مائل مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد مستندين على فخذيك.
استلقِ على المقعد واستخدم فخذيك للمساعدة في رفع الدمبلين إلى مستوى الكتفين مع توجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأمام.
بمجرد وصولهما إلى مستوى الكتفين، أدر معصميك حتى تتجه راحتا يديك إلى الأمام.
ادفع الدمبلين إلى الأعلى باستخدام صدرك وكتفيك مع مد ذراعيك بالكامل.
أنزل الدمبلين عائدين إلى وضع البداية مع إبقاء مرفقيك مثنيين قليلاً.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب مع التبديل بين الذراعين.

name: ضغط الكتف جالساً بالتناوب بالدمبل
description: A seated dumbbell shoulder press with the arms alternating. It trains the delts and triceps.
instructions: اجلس على مقعد مع استقامة ظهرك ووضع قدميك على الأرض.
أمسك دمبل في كل يد مع توجيه راحتي يديك إلى الداخل وارفعهما إلى مستوى الكتفين.
ادفع دمبلاً واحداً فوق رأسك مع إبقاء الدمبل الآخر عند مستوى الكتفين.
أنزل الدمبل المرفوع عائداً إلى مستوى الكتفين مع دفع الدمبل الآخر فوق رأسك في الوقت نفسه.
استمر في التبديل بين الذراعين للعدد المطلوب.

name: بايسبس كيرل جالساً ثم ضغط الكتف بالدمبل
englishName: dumbbell seated biceps curl to shoulder press
description: A seated dumbbell curl that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains the biceps and shoulders in one rep.
instructions: اجلس على مقعد مع استقامة ظهرك ووضع قدميك على الأرض.
أمسك دمبل في كل يد مع توجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأمام ومد ذراعيك بالكامل.
اثنِ الدمبلين نحو كتفيك مع إبقاء مرفقيك قريبين من جانبيك.
بمجرد أن يصبح ساعداك عموديين، أدر معصميك حتى تتجه راحتا يديك إلى الأمام.
ادفع الدمبلين فوق رأسك حتى تمد ذراعيك بالكامل.
أنزل الدمبلين عائدين إلى وضع البداية بعكس الحركة.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: حمل فوق الرأس بذراع واحدة بالدمبل
description: A one-handed overhead carry, walking while holding a dumbbell above your head. It trains the shoulders, core and balance.
instructions: قف مستقيماً مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين وإمساك دمبل بيد واحدة.
ارفع الدمبل فوق رأسك مع مد ذراعك بالكامل.
شد عضلات جذعك وحافظ على استقامة ظهرك أثناء المشي إلى الأمام مع إبقاء الدمبل فوق رأسك.
استمر في المشي للمسافة أو المدة المطلوبة.
بدّل اليدين وكرر الحركة.

name: هيب ثراست على الجهاز (بالأقراص)
description: Plate-loaded machine hip thrust for heavy glute work.
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and belt secured over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder width apart.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

name: عقلة جالساً بين الكراسي
description: A seated pull-up using a bar between two chairs, with the legs assisting.
instructions: Set a bar across two sturdy chairs.
Sit on the floor beneath it and grip the bar.
Keep your legs bent for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower with control.
Use your legs as little as possible.

name: عدو جانبي سريع
description: A lateral shuttle run at speed to raise the heart rate.
instructions: Stand with knees bent in an athletic stance.
Shuffle to one side in quick steps.
Touch the floor or change direction.
Shuffle back the other way.
Keep your chest up.
Keep up the pace for 30-60 seconds.

name: خطوات سريعة v. 2
description: A quick on-the-spot footwork drill with fast, light steps. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين وذراعيك بجانب جسمك.
ابدأ بتحريك قدميك بسرعة إلى الأعلى والأسفل كما لو كنت تجري في مكانك.
حافظ على حركات سريعة وخفيفة مع التركيز على البقاء على باطن قدميك.
استمر في التمرين للمدة أو للعدد المطلوب.

name: ضغط دوراني
description: A push-up with a rotation and arm reach at the top. It works the chest and trunk.
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up and rotate, reaching one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Lower again for the next rep.
Alternate sides.

name: هامر كيرل بالزجاجة
description: A hammer curl with water bottles as light weights. It trains the biceps and forearms.
instructions: Hold a filled bottle in each hand with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl the bottles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

name: دفع بعيداً بقوة
description: An explosive push away from a wall or support to train the upper back.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and lean in with arms extended.
Push away from the wall forcefully.
Retract your shoulder blades as you reach back.
Return to the wall with control.
Keep your core tight.
Reset between reps.

name: ركض بركبتين عاليتين
description: A running-in-place move with high knees. It raises the heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving your knees up toward waist height.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

name: ضغط على الركبتين بيدين واسعتين
description: A kneeling push-up with the hands wider apart. It puts more emphasis on the chest.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

name: بايسبس كيرل من الاستلقاء بمنشفة
description: Lie on your back and curl a towel held in both hands toward your chest, using your own resistance to work the biceps.
instructions: Lie on your back and hold a towel in both hands, arms extended.
Pull the towel taut and curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

name: تجديف سوبرمان بمنشفة
description: Lie face down with a towel held taut overhead, lift your chest and pull the towel toward you, training the upper back and spine.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead, holding a towel taut.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull the towel down toward your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward again with control.
Keep your neck neutral and repeat.

name: هامر كيرل ثم ضغط بالتناوب بالدمبل واقفاً
englishName: dumbbell standing alternate hammer curl and press
description: A standing dumbbell sequence that alternates hammer curls with overhead presses. It trains the biceps and shoulders.
instructions: قف باستقامة مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد مع توجيه راحتي يديك نحو جسمك.
أبقِ مرفقيك قريبين من جذعك وحافظ على استقامة ظهرك.
أخرج الزفير واثنِ الدمبل في يدك اليمنى نحو كتفك مع إبقاء ذراعك العلوية ثابتة.
استمر في رفع الدمبل حتى ينقبض البايسبس بالكامل ويصل الدمبل إلى مستوى الكتف.
خذ شهيقاً وأنزل الدمبل ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الثني بيدك اليسرى.
أكمل الثني بيدك اليسرى، ثم أخرج الزفير وادفع الدمبل في يدك اليمنى فوق رأسك.
مد ذراعك بالكامل وثبت لحظة في أعلى الحركة.
خذ شهيقاً وأنزل الدمبل ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الدفع بيدك اليسرى.
استمر في التبديل بين الثني والدفع للعدد المطلوب.

name: مسيرة جسر الألوية
description: A glute bridge held at the top while you alternate marching the knees. It trains the glutes and core stability.
instructions: استلقِ على ظهرك مع ثني ركبتيك ووضع قدميك على الأرض.
شد عضلات المؤخرة وارفع وركيك عن الأرض مع تشكيل خط مستقيم من ركبتيك إلى كتفيك.
مع الحفاظ على وركيك مرفوعين، ارفع قدماً واحدة عن الأرض وقرّب ركبتك نحو صدرك.
أنزل قدمك عائدة إلى الأرض وكرر الحركة مع الساق الأخرى.
استمر في التبديل بين الساقين بحركة تشبه السير مع الحفاظ على وضع الجسر.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: جسر الألوية بالبار والساقان على المقعد (ذكر)
englishName: barbell glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
description: A barbell glute bridge with your upper back on a bench and a bar across the hips. It builds the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: ابدأ بالجلوس على حافة مقعد مع إسناد الجزء العلوي من ظهرك عليه ووضع قدميك على الأرض بعرض الوركين.
ضع البار عبر وركيك مع إمساكه بإحكام بكلتا يديك.
شد عضلات المؤخرة وعضلات جذعك، ثم ادفع عبر كعبيك لرفع وركيك عن المقعد مع تشكيل خط مستقيم من ركبتيك إلى كتفيك.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة مع الضغط على عضلات المؤخرة.
أنزل وركيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: سحب بالكابل بذراع واحدة
description: A one arm cable pulldown from a high pulley, pulling the handle down to your side. It trains the lats.
instructions: ثبّت مقبضاً واحداً على جهاز كيبل ببكرة عالية.
قف في مواجهة الجهاز مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين.
أمسك المقبض بقبضة علوية ومد ذراعك بالكامل.
حافظ على استقامة ظهرك وشد عضلات جذعك.
اسحب المقبض نحو جانبك مع إبقاء مرفقك قريباً من جسمك.
توقف لحظة في أسفل الحركة مع الضغط على عضلات الظهر الجانبية.
حرر المقبض ببطء عائداً إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.
بدّل الجانبين وكرر الحركة بالذراع الأخرى.

name: تمدد خافض وساحب ومثني الكتف جالساً (ركبة مثنية)
englishName: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch (bent knee)
description: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulder and lengthens the muscles that lift and pull the arm.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one knee bent and the other leg comfortable.
Place your hands behind you on the floor, fingers pointing away.
Slowly slide your hips forward while keeping your chest tall.
Feel the stretch in the front of your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تمدد يوجا وضعية الجسر
description: A deep backbend where you press up from the floor, opening the chest and hips and strengthening the back of the body.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your hands beside your head, palms down, fingers toward your shoulders.
Press through hands and feet to lift your hips and chest.
Straighten your arms as far as is comfortable and relax your neck.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

name: دحرجة الجزء العلوي من الظهر
description: Roll your upper back over a foam roller to loosen tight spots and improve thoracic mobility.
instructions: Sit with a foam roller behind your upper back and lie back onto it.
Cross your arms over your chest and lift your hips.
Roll slowly between your shoulder blades and mid back.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Avoid rolling your lower back and continue for about a minute.

name: دحرجة تمدد مدور ومبسط الورك الخارجي من الاستلقاء (ساق متقاطعة)
englishName: roll recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
description: Lying on your back with one ankle crossed over the other knee, pull the legs in to stretch the glutes and deep hip rotators.
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تدليك العضلة الكمثرية بكرة الرول
description: Use a small ball under the buttock to ease tension in the piriformis and deep hip muscles.
instructions: Sit on the floor and place a ball under one buttock.
Cross that ankle over the opposite knee for more access.
Shift your weight to find a tender spot and stay there.
Breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds, then roll gently.
Switch sides.

name: تدليك عضلة الصدر بكرة الرول
description: Pin a ball between your chest and a wall to release tight pectoral muscles.
instructions: Place a ball between your chest and a wall, just below the collarbone.
Lean in until you feel pressure on the chest muscle.
Roll slowly in small circles or up and down.
Hold on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch sides after about 30-60 seconds.

name: تدليك العضلة شبه المنحرفة العلوية بكرة الرول
description: Roll a ball against a wall under the top of your shoulder to relieve tight upper trapezius muscles.
instructions: Stand with your back to a wall and place a ball on top of one shoulder.
Lean into the wall to press the ball into the muscle.
Move slowly by bending your knees.
Pause on tender spots and breathe.
Switch to the other shoulder.

name: سوينغ كامل بالكيتل بيل
description: An explosive hip hinge that swings the kettlebell overhead, training the glutes, hamstrings and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, kettlebell on the floor in front.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to swing it overhead.
Let it fall back between your legs while hinging again.
Keep your back flat and repeat in a smooth rhythm.

name: ضغط صارم بالكيتل بيل
description: A standing overhead press with a kettlebell and no leg drive, focused on shoulder strength.
instructions: Hold the kettlebell at shoulder height in the rack position.
Stand tall with glutes and abs tight.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is locked out.
Lower it back to the shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: ضغط سوتس بالكيتل بيل
description: Press kettlebells overhead from the bottom of a deep squat to challenge shoulder stability and hip mobility.
instructions: Hold kettlebells in the rack position and sink into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up and heels flat.
Press the bells overhead while staying in the squat.
Lower them back to the shoulders with control.
Stand up and repeat once the set is done.

name: اندفاع أمامي بالكيتل بيل
description: A lunge stepping forward while holding a kettlebell, working the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs for the set.

name: اندفاع خلفي بالكيتل بيل
description: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell, friendly on the knees while building glutes and thighs.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and torso tall.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

name: حمل المزارع بالكيتل بيل
description: Walk while holding heavy kettlebells at your sides to build grip, posture and total body stability.
instructions: Stand between two kettlebells and pick them up with a flat back.
Stand tall with shoulders back and arms straight.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Keep your core braced and avoid leaning.
Set the weights down carefully after the distance.

name: اندفاع وكلين وضغط بالكيتل بيل
description: Combine a lunge with a kettlebell clean and overhead press for a full body strength move.
instructions: Start standing with a kettlebell hanging in one hand.
Step back into a lunge while cleaning the bell to your shoulder.
Rise from the lunge and press the bell overhead.
Lower the bell to the shoulder, then to your side.
Alternate legs and switch hands after the set.

name: سلينج شوت بالكيتل بيل
description: Pass a kettlebell around your waist in a circle to build core control and coordination.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hold the kettlebell in one hand.
Pass it behind your back to the other hand.
Bring it around your waist to the front.
Keep your hips square and core tight.
Repeat in the same direction, then reverse.

name: ديك سكوات بالكيتل بيل
description: Roll back onto the floor holding a kettlebell from a squat, then roll up into a squat again.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and squat down.
Sit back and roll onto your back, keeping the bell close.
Use momentum to roll forward onto your feet.
Stand up out of the squat.
Keep a tight grip and repeat smoothly.

name: ضغط عميق بالكيتل بيل
description: A push-up with hands on kettlebell handles to lower the chest deeper than the floor allows.
instructions: Place two kettlebells shoulder width apart and grip the handles.
Set up in a straight plank position.
Lower your chest below your hands with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

name: اندفاع مع رفع الساق
description: A lunge followed by lifting the back leg, working the glutes and balance.
instructions: Stand tall and step one leg forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press up and lift the rear leg behind or beside you.
Hold briefly with your core tight.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.

name: اندفاع مع قفز
description: A lunge followed by a jump where the legs switch in mid-air. It builds leg power and raises your heart rate.
instructions: ابدأ بالوقوف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين.
تقدم خطوة إلى الأمام بقدمك اليمنى مع إنزال جسمك إلى وضع اللانج.
ادفع بقدمك اليمنى واقفز في الهواء مع تبديل وضعية قدميك في منتصف القفزة.
اهبط بنعومة مع تقدم قدمك اليسرى وأنزل جسمك فوراً إلى وضعية اللانج.
استمر في التبديل بين اللانجات والقفزات للعدد المطلوب.

name: جسر بساق واحدة مع ثني الورك
englishName: single leg bridge with hip flexion
description: A one-legged glute bridge with the other knee drawn up, building glute strength and pelvic control.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Press through the other foot to raise your hips.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

name: جسر جانبي مع أرجحة الذراع والساق
englishName: side bridge with arm leg swing
description: A side plank with the top arm and leg swinging, challenging the obliques and balance.
instructions: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise the top leg and arm.
Swing them toward each other under control.
Keep your hips high, then switch sides.

name: ديدلفت بساق واحدة مع رفع الركبة
englishName: single leg deadlift with knee lift
description: A single-leg hip hinge that ends with a knee drive, training balance, hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge forward as the other leg extends behind you.
Return to upright by squeezing the glute.
Drive the free knee up toward your chest.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

name: مقص (متقدم)
description: Hold both legs low and cross them repeatedly like scissors, working the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips.
Lift your head, shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Alternate sides in a controlled rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

name: رفع ساق واحدة بوزن إضافي
description: Lift one leg while loaded with ankle weight, targeting the glutes and hip extensors.
instructions: Wear ankle weights and get on hands and knees or lie face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Raise the weighted leg without swinging.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

name: تحريك الذراعين بسرعة في المكان
description: Swing your arms quickly while standing to warm up the shoulders and raise your heart rate.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and knees soft.
Swing both arms across your chest and open wide.
Keep your torso upright and relaxed.
Increase speed gradually.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

name: هرولة سريعة في المكان
description: Trot in place at a quick pace to warm up and get your heart rate up.
instructions: Stand tall with arms bent at your sides.
Lift your knees and run lightly on the spot.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms with each step.
Keep the pace for 30-60 seconds or longer.

name: رفع الساق بالتناوب من الاستلقاء على الأرض
description: Raise one leg at a time while lying on the floor, working the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg to about 90 degrees.
Lower it slowly and lift the other leg.
Alternate without arching your back.

name: لف بالحبل المطاطي
description: A standing rotation against band resistance for the obliques and core.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Stand sideways with arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the anchor.
Return under control.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

name: بايسبس كيرل بالبار
description: The standard standing barbell curl. A simple and effective way to build the biceps.
instructions: قف باستقامة مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين وأمسك البار بقبضة سفلية مع توجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأمام.
حافظ على مرفقيك قريبين من جذعك وأخرج الزفير أثناء ثني الوزنين مع انقباض البايسبس.
استمر في رفع البار حتى ينقبض البايسبس بالكامل ويصل البار إلى مستوى الكتفين.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة مع الضغط على البايسبس.
خذ شهيقاً أثناء إنزال البار ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: سكوات بالبار
description: The classic barbell squat that builds strength in the thighs and hips.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.

name: ديدلفت بالبار بساقين مستقيمتين
description: A deadlift with nearly straight legs, which targets the hamstrings.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين مع توجيه أصابع قدميك إلى الأمام.
أمسك البار بقبضة علوية مع مباعدة اليدين بمسافة أوسع قليلاً من عرض الكتفين.
انحنِ عند وركيك وأنزل البار نحو الأرض مع الحفاظ على استقامة ظهرك وثني ركبتيك قليلاً.
أنزل البار حتى تشعر بتمدد في أوتار الركبة.
شد أوتار الركبة وعضلات المؤخرة لرفع البار عائداً إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: سحب عمودي بالبار بقبضة واسعة
description: A wide-grip upright row, favouring the side delts and traps.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين وأمسك البار بقبضة علوية مع مباعدة اليدين بمسافة أوسع من عرض الكتفين.
اترك البار يتدلى أمام فخذيك مع مد ذراعيك بالكامل.
مع الحفاظ على استقامة ظهرك، أخرج الزفير وارفع البار نحو ذقنك مع قيادة الحركة بمرفقيك.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم خذ شهيقاً وأنزل البار ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: سحب أمامي بالكابل بذراع واحدة
description: A single-arm pulldown on a high cable. It lets each side of the lats work on its own.
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

name: تجديف جالس مع لف بالكابل بذراع واحدة
englishName: cable one arm twisting seated row
description: A seated one-arm cable row with a rotation of the torso. It trains the back and gives the core a twist.
instructions: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.

name: تجديف جالس بالكابل بقبضة واسعة
description: A seated cable row with a wide grip handle. The wide hold puts more emphasis on the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: اجلس على جهاز التجديف بالكيبل مع وضع قدميك على مساند القدمين وثني ركبتيك قليلاً.
أمسك المقبض بقبضة علوية واسعة مع توجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأسفل.
حافظ على استقامة ظهرك وانحنِ إلى الأمام قليلاً من الوركين.
اسحب المقبض نحو الجزء السفلي من صدرك مع سحب لوحي كتفيك للخلف وللداخل.
توقف لحظة في ذروة الانقباض.
حرر المقبض ببطء عائداً إلى وضع البداية مع مد ذراعيك بالكامل.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: غطس الصدر
description: A bodyweight dip with a forward lean on parallel bars. It targets the lower chest, triceps and shoulders.
instructions: ضع نفسك على البارين المتوازيين مع مد ذراعيك بالكامل واستقامة جسمك.
أنزل جسمك عن طريق ثني مرفقيك حتى ينخفض كتفاك تحت مرفقيك.
ادفع بجسمك عائداً إلى وضع البداية عن طريق مد ذراعيك.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: عقلة بقبضة متوازية ضيقة
description: A chin-up on a bar with a narrow parallel grip and the palms facing in. It works the lats, upper back and biceps.
instructions: تعلق على بار العقلة بقبضة متوازية ضيقة مع توجيه راحتي يديك نحوك.
شد عضلات ظهرك واسحب جسمك نحو البار مع إبقاء مرفقيك قريبين من جسمك.
استمر في السحب حتى يصبح ذقنك فوق البار.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أنزل جسمك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: الصليب الحديدي بالدمبل
description: A dumbbell lateral raise to a T position, like an iron cross. It strengthens the delts and the upper back.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد بجانبيك.
ارفع ذراعيك إلى الجانبين حتى تصبحا موازيتين للأرض.
توقف لحظة، ثم أنزل ذراعيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: كيرل من الاستلقاء على الظهر بالدمبل
description: You lie on a bench and curl dumbbells with palms up. The lying position keeps the biceps working under steady tension.
instructions: استلقِ على مقعد مسطح مع إمساك دمبل في كل يد وتوجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأعلى ومد ذراعيك بالكامل.
حافظ على ثبات ذراعيك العلويين وأخرج الزفير أثناء ثني الوزنين مع انقباض البايسبس.
استمر في رفع الدمبلين حتى ينقبض البايسبس بالكامل ويصلا إلى مستوى الكتفين.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة مع الضغط على البايسبس.
خذ شهيقاً وابدأ في إنزال الدمبلين ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: ضغط مضاد للجاذبية بالبار المتعرج
description: An EZ-bar press with a gravity-fighting path that works the shoulders and triceps. Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
instructions: ابدأ بالوقوف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين وإمساك بار EZ بقبضة علوية.
ارفع البار إلى مستوى الكتفين مع إبقاء مرفقيك مثنيين قليلاً وراحتي يديك متجهتين إلى الأمام.
ادفع البار فوق رأسك مع مد ذراعيك بالكامل.
أنزل البار عائداً إلى مستوى الكتفين وكرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: رفع الورك بساقين مستقيمتين من التعلق
description: Hanging from a bar, you lift your straight legs and raise the hips. It trains the lower abs.
instructions: تعلق على بار العقلة مع فرد ذراعيك بالكامل وتوجيه راحتي يديك بعيداً عنك.
شد عضلات جذعك وارفع ساقيك أمامك حتى تصبحا موازيتين للأرض.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أنزل ساقيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: لاندماين 180
description: You hold a landmine barbell at chest height and rotate it in an arc from side to side. Works the obliques and core with strong hip drive.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين وأمسك البار بكلتا يديك أمام صدرك.
اثنِ ركبتيك قليلاً وأدر جذعك إلى اليمين مع أرجحة البار نحو وركك الأيمن.
في أسفل الحركة، اعكس الحركة بسرعة وأدر جذعك إلى اليسار مع أرجحة البار إلى الأعلى وعبر جسمك نحو كتفك الأيسر.
استمر في حركة اللف هذه مع التبديل بين الجانبين للعدد المطلوب.

name: كرنش مع تمديد الساق (بكرة التوازن)
description: A crunch on a stability ball combined with extending the legs for a deep ab workout.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up as you extend one leg.
Lower slowly and bend the knee.
Alternate legs for the set.

name: تمديد الظهر على الجهاز
description: On a machine, you extend your torso against a pad to work the lower back. Also brings in the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: اضبط الجهاز ليناسب حجم جسمك ومدى حركتك.
اجلس على الجهاز مع إسناد ظهرك على الوسادة وتثبيت قدميك.
ضع يديك على المقابض أو قضبان الإمساك.
شد عضلات جذعك وانحنِ ببطء إلى الأمام مع السماح لظهرك بالاستدارة قليلاً.
توقف لحظة في أسفل الوضعية مع الشعور بتمدد في أسفل ظهرك.
باستخدام عضلات ظهرك، ارفع جذعك ببطء عائداً إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: ضغط صدر هامر مائل للأعلى على الجهاز
description: Pressing on an incline chest machine with neutral hammer handles. It builds the upper chest and is gentle on the shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.

name: ليج كيرل على الركبتين على الجهاز
description: Kneeling on a machine, you curl your lower legs up against a pad. Isolates the hamstrings.
instructions: اضبط الجهاز ليناسب جسمك واختر الوزن المطلوب.
اركع على الجهاز متجهاً إلى الأسفل مع إسناد ركبتيك على الوسادة وتثبيت قدميك تحت مساند القدمين.
أمسك المقابض أو جوانب الجهاز للثبات.
مع الحفاظ على ثبات الجزء العلوي من جسمك، أخرج الزفير واثنِ ساقيك نحو عضلات المؤخرة عن طريق ثني ركبتيك.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة مع الضغط على أوتار الركبة.
خذ شهيقاً وأنزل ساقيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية مع مد ركبتيك بالكامل.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: ضغط الصدر من الاستلقاء على الجهاز (بالأقراص)
description: A plate-loaded press from a lying position, working the chest with a guided path.
