instructions: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Keep walking, alternating legs, with an upright torso.

name: وضعية يوغا المحارب الثاني
description: A strong standing pose with wide legs and arms outstretched, building leg strength, hip opening and stamina.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Gaze over your front fingertips and keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

name: رفع أمامي عالٍ بالبار جالساً
description: A seated barbell raise that lifts the bar high in front of you, working the front delts.
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, in front of your thighs.
Keep your back straight and your core braced.
Lift the bar forward and up to eye level or higher.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly under control.

name: فصل الحبل المطاطي (قبضة سفلية عند 90 درجة)
description: A band pull-apart with an overhand grip and arms at 90 degrees that hits the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand holding a band in front of you at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

name: بنش برس بالبار مع كيتل بيل معلق بالحبل المطاطي
englishName: barbell bench press with band suspended kettlebell
description: A bench press with kettlebells hanging from bands on the bar. The swinging load forces your stabilising muscles to work harder.
instructions: Lie on a bench and unrack the barbell with kettlebells hung from bands.
Plant your feet and brace your core.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press it up to full extension while keeping the bar steady.
Rack the bar safely when finished.

name: عقلة بمقاومة الحبل المطاطي
description: A chin-up with a band adding resistance, building the lats and biceps.
instructions: Attach a band to the bar and loop it around your body or waist.
Hang from the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.

name: بيرد دوغ مع انزلاق الساق
description: A bird dog variation where the leg slides along the floor, improving core stability and coordination.
instructions: Start on all fours with a sliding disc or towel under one foot.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Slide that leg straight back as you extend the opposite arm forward.
Return to the start in a controlled way.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

name: سومو سكوات مع لمس الأرض
description: A wide-stance squat in which you touch the floor between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and squat down.
Touch the floor with your fingertips between your feet.
Keep your chest lifted and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

name: رفع الساق من الاستلقاء (معدل)
description: An easier lying leg raise that trains the lower abs. Bent knees reduce the strain on the lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until your hips flex to about 90 degrees.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop short of the floor and repeat.

name: مشي في المكان
description: A low-impact cardio move where you march in place to raise your heart rate and warm up the legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your steps.
Keep a steady pace for 1-3 minutes.

name: دونكي كيك باك بالكابل
description: Kicking one leg back from a hands-and-knees position against cable resistance. It isolates the glutes.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and get on all fours facing the machine.
Hook the strap around one ankle.
Keeping the knee bent, drive your heel up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch legs.

name: درَغ بايسبس كيرل بالبار المتعرج
description: A curl where the bar drags up your torso with elbows pulled back. It keeps tension on the biceps and reduces shoulder help.
instructions: Stand holding an ez bar with an underhand grip at your thighs.
Keep the bar close to your body.
Curl it up while moving your elbows back behind you.
Let the bar slide up your torso to chest height.
Lower slowly under control.

name: تجديف من الاستلقاء بقبضة ضيقة سفلية بالبار على الرف
englishName: barbell lying close grip underhand row on rack
description: A bodyweight row hanging under a barbell set in a rack, using a close underhand grip to target the lats and biceps.
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie underneath and grab it with a close underhand grip.
Keep your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower yourself under control.

name: تجديف من الاستلقاء بقبضة ضيقة علوية بالبار على الرف
englishName: barbell lying close grip overhand row on rack
description: A bodyweight row under a rack-mounted barbell with a close overhand grip, targeting the upper back and lats.
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie beneath it and grip the bar overhand with hands close together.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Pull your chest to the bar and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.

name: تجديف من الاستلقاء بقبضة ضيقة متوازية بالدمبل على الرف
englishName: dumbbell lying close grip parallel row on rack
description: A chest-supported row lying on a rack with a neutral grip, working the lats and mid back.
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench or rack with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row the dumbbells toward your ribs, keeping elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: تجديف من الاستلقاء بقبضة واسعة بالدمبل على الرف
englishName: dumbbell lying wide grip row on rack
description: A chest-supported row with a wide elbow path that emphasises the upper back and rear delts.
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the dumbbells up with elbows flaring out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower under control.

name: ثني الساق الواحدة من الاستلقاء على الجهاز
description: A lying hamstring curl on a machine using one leg at a time. It helps balance strength between legs.
instructions: Lie face down on the machine and place one leg under the pad above your heel.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel up toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

name: دفع سليد القوة
description: A heavy sled push that builds leg drive and conditioning.
instructions: Load the sled and grip the handles at chest or hip height.
Lean forward with a straight body line.
Drive through your legs with powerful steps.
Keep your core tight and push the sled forward.
Maintain a steady pace for the set distance.

name: رفع الرقبة جانباً بالوزن من الاستلقاء
description: A gentle neck exercise lying on your side and lifting the head against light resistance to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side with your head supported at the edge of the bench.
Place a light weight or plate on the side of your head, held steady.
Lift your head slowly toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides. Use light weight.

name: رفع الرقبة جانباً بالوزن من الاستلقاء الجانبي
englishName: weighted side lying side neck raise
description: A gentle neck exercise lying on your side and lifting the head against light resistance to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side with your head supported at the edge of the bench.
Place a light weight or plate on the side of your head, held steady.
Lift your head slowly toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides. Use light weight.

name: حركة الرقبة من جانب لآخر بالوزن من الاستلقاء
englishName: weighted lying neck side to side
description: A lying neck exercise moving the head side to side against light resistance to strengthen the neck.
instructions: Lie face up with a light weight on your forehead.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head toward one side.
Return to the middle and turn the other way.
Use light weight and smooth movement.

name: لف الرأس بالوزن من الاستلقاء
description: A lying neck twist with light resistance to work the muscles that rotate the head.
instructions: Lie face up with a light weight resting on your forehead.
Keep your chin slightly tucked.
Rotate your head slowly to one side.
Return to the middle and rotate to the other side.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

name: سكوات برفع الركبة العالي v. 2
description: A squat followed by a high knee drive, combining leg strength with a bit of cardio.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest lifted.
Stand up explosively and drive one knee up toward your chest.
Land softly and drop into the next squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

name: خطوة جانبية بالتناوب
description: A low-impact move stepping one leg out at a time, raising your heart rate while working the legs.
instructions: Stand with feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step one foot out to the side.
Bring it back and step the other foot out.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

name: ليج كيرل بالتناوب مع لكمات
description: A cardio combination of heel-to-glute kicks and punches that works the hamstrings and arms together.
instructions: Stand tall with your fists in front of your chin.
Curl one heel up toward your glute.
Punch forward as you curl the leg.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm and stay light on your feet.

name: خطوة جاك
description: A low-impact version of the jumping jack where you step out instead of jumping.
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising your arms overhead.
Step it back as you lower your arms.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

name: باور كلين وجيرك بالدمبل
description: An explosive lift pulling dumbbells from the floor to the shoulders and then overhead.
instructions: Stand over dumbbells with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip them with a flat back.
Pull explosively, extend your hips and shrug.
Catch the dumbbells at your shoulders, then dip and drive them overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then the floor with control.

name: صعود المقعد بالكيتل بيل v. 2
description: A step-up with a kettlebell, held in a different position, to train the quads and glutes unilaterally.
instructions: Stand facing a bench or box holding a kettlebell.
Place one foot flat on the box.
Press through that heel to stand up.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: اندفاع بالمشي بالكيتل بيل على الكتف الأمامي
description: Walking lunges with kettlebells held in the front rack position. Builds leg strength while the core works to keep you upright.
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the front rack, elbows tucked and close to your ribs.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Keep your torso upright and the bells steady against your chest.
Continue alternating legs for the planned distance.

name: بلغاريان سبليت سكوات بمساعدة
description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot raised on a bench and a hand lightly holding a support for balance. Trains quads and glutes with less wobble.
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench and hold a sturdy post or rack with one hand for balance.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

name: بلغاريان سبليت سكوات بالدمبل بمساعدة
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a dumbbell in one hand and the other hand on a support. Builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

name: بلغاريان سبليت سكوات بالكيتل بيل بمساعدة
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat holding a kettlebell, with a free hand on a support. Builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

name: فيس بول بالحبل المطاطي جالساً
description: A seated band pull toward the face that targets the rear delts and upper back. Good for shoulder health and posture.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and sit facing it, holding the ends with both hands.
Sit tall with arms extended and the band under light tension.
Pull the band toward your face, flaring your elbows out and high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly, then return slowly with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

name: ضغط بذراع واحدة بالكيتل بيل مقلوباً على ركبة واحدة
englishName: kettlebell half kneeling one arm bottoms up press
description: A one-arm overhead press with the kettlebell held upside down from a half-kneeling stance. Challenges shoulder stability, grip and core.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the opposite foot flat in front, back upright.
Hold a kettlebell by the handle with the bell pointing up, at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and brace your core.
Press straight overhead while keeping the bell balanced.
Lower under control back to the shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: جسر الأرداف مرتفعاً بالحبل المطاطي
description: A glute bridge with your feet raised and a band adding resistance. Targets the glutes with a deep range of motion.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet on a bench and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Bend your knees and place your arms by your sides.
Push your knees out against the band and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

name: هيب ثراست بالبار مع الحبل المطاطي
description: A barbell hip thrust with a band around the knees to add outward tension. Strongly works the glutes and hip stabilisers.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench, a padded barbell over your hips and a band above your knees.
Plant your feet hip width apart and push your knees out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Keep your chin tucked and ribs down.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: هانغ كلين بالدمبل
description: Explosive lift taking dumbbells from hip level to the shoulders. Builds power through the hips and back.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs, then push your hips back to lower them to the knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward powerfully and shrug.
Pull the dumbbells up close to your body and rotate your elbows under them.
Catch them on your shoulders in a slight quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower them back to your thighs and reset.

name: تجديف مقلوب بقبضة واسعة بأحزمة التعليق
description: A bodyweight row hanging under straps with a wide grip. Works the upper back and lats while the core keeps you rigid.
instructions: Hold the handles of a suspension trainer with a wide overhand grip and lean back, arms straight.
Walk your feet forward to set the difficulty.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight.

name: تجديف مقلوب بقبضة واسعة بالتعليق على الأرض
englishName: suspension wide grip inverted row on floor
description: A bodyweight row hanging under suspension straps with a wide grip. It builds the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Hold the handles with a wide, overhand grip and lie back with your body straight.
Keep your heels on the floor and your core tight.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

name: تجديف منحني بقبضة واسعة بالحبل المطاطي
englishName: band bent over wide grip row
description: A bent-over row with a band and a wide grip. Targets the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip width apart and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your torso still throughout.

name: تجديف سفلي بقبضة واسعة بذراع واحدة واقفاً بالحبل المطاطي
englishName: band one arm standing wide grip low row
description: A standing single-arm row from a low anchor, using a band. Trains the lats and mid back one side at a time.
instructions: Anchor a band low and stand facing it, holding the end in one hand.
Step back until the band is taut, feet hip width apart.
Pull your elbow back and out, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: تجديف بقبضة واسعة بالحبل المطاطي جالساً
description: Seated rowing with a band and a wide grip. It works the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and loop the band around your feet.
Grab the band with a wide grip and sit tall.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control and repeat.

name: تمرين الظهر بزاوية 45 درجة
description: A back extension on an angled bench that strengthens the lower back and glutes. Hinging at the hips keeps the movement safe and smooth.
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them behind your head.
Lower your torso with a straight spine until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso by squeezing your glutes and lower back.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Avoid over-arching at the top.

name: غلوت هام ريز v. 2
description: A posterior chain exercise on a glute ham bench. Works the hamstrings and glutes through a long range of motion.
instructions: Set your feet on the platform with your thighs against the pad and knees just behind it.
Start with your torso hanging down and your body straight.
Curl your body up by bending your knees and squeezing your hamstrings.
Finish with hips extended and torso upright.
Lower slowly with control, keeping your hips locked.
Repeat for reps.

name: جسر جانبي بساق مثنية بالدمبل
englishName: dumbbell side bridge with bent leg
description: A side plank on a bent knee holding a dumbbell. Strengthens the obliques and trunk while teaching stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, resting on your hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from head to knees.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep your hips stacked and do not sink.
Lower and switch sides after your set.

name: جسر جانبي بساقين مستقيمتين
description: A side plank with both legs straight, held on one forearm. It strengthens the obliques and hips.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your core tight and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds without letting your hips sag.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.

name: ضغط البطن من الاستلقاء
description: A lying core move where you press your arms and legs together to crunch the abs. Targets the front of the trunk.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Brace your abs and press your lower back to the floor.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees toward your chest.
Reach your hands to your knees and squeeze.
Return slowly without letting your feet touch down.
Repeat for reps.

name: ضغط البطن من الاستلقاء

instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Brace your abs and press your lower back to the floor.

Reach your hands to your knees and squeeze.
Return slowly without letting your feet touch down.

name: جسر جانبي بساق مثنية
description: Side plank with the knees bent for a gentler version. It builds the obliques and hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from shoulder to knee.
Keep your hips stacked and core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

name: تدليك القدم بالكرة
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the foot sole. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your foot sole while seated or standing.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تدليك شبه المنحرفة السفلية بالكرة
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the lower trapezius. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your lower trapezius while leaning back against a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تدليك شبه المنحرفة السفلية بالكرة v. 2
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the lower trapezius. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your lower trapezius while lying on your back on the floor.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تدليك الظهرية العريضة بالكرة
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the side of the back (latissimus dorsi). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your side of the back (latissimus dorsi) while lying on your side with your arm overhead.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تدليك قابضات الساعد بالكرة
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the inside of the forearm (flexors). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your inside of the forearm (flexors) on a table with your palm facing up.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تدليك مسطحة الساعد بالكرة
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the upper forearm (supinator). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your upper forearm (supinator) on a table with your arm resting on it.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تدليك باسطات الساعد بالكرة
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the top of the forearm (extensors). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your top of the forearm (extensors) on a table with your palm facing down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تدليك كابّة الساعد بالكرة
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the inner forearm near the elbow (pronator). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your inner forearm near the elbow (pronator) on a table with your palm facing up.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

name: تدليك العضلة ذات الرأسين العضدية بالكرة
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the front of the upper arm (biceps brachii). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your front of the upper arm (biceps brachii) on a table or against a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

name: سكوات كامل بوزن الجسم مع ضغط علوي
englishName: bodyweight full squat with overhead press
description: A deep squat followed by a press overhead. Warms up legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs pass parallel.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Press both arms overhead as you reach the top.
Lower your hands back to your shoulders.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

name: من بلانك أمامي إلى الكلب المقلوب بوزن الجسم
englishName: bodyweight front plank to downward dog
description: Moves between a plank and downward dog. Builds core strength and opens up the hamstrings and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Push your hips up and back into an inverted V.
Press your heels toward the floor and lengthen your spine.
Return to plank with control.
Keep moving smoothly for reps.

name: لمس الكتف على الركبتين
description: A kneeling plank with alternating shoulder taps. Trains anti-rotation core control and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees slightly into a kneeling plank.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place it back down without rocking your hips.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your abs tight throughout.

name: وضعية الفراشة (يوغا)
description: A seated pose with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out. It opens the inner thighs and hips.
instructions: اجلس على الأرض مع مد ساقيك أمامك.
اثنِ ركبتيك وضم باطن قدميك معاً مع السماح لركبتيك بالانخفاض إلى الجانبين.
أمسك كاحليك أو قدميك بيديك.
اجلس باستقامة مع إطالة عمودك الفقري.
اضغط ركبتيك بلطف نحو الأرض مع الشعور بتمدد في فخذيك الداخليين.
حافظ على هذه الوضعية لعدة أنفاس.
للتحرر، ارفع ركبتيك ببطء عائدتين إلى الأعلى ومد ساقيك.

name: تمدد الذقن نحو الصدر
description: A gentle neck stretch that lengthens the muscles at the back of the neck. Useful after long periods of sitting.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Place your hands lightly on the back of your head if you want a deeper stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to neutral.

name: تمدد السمانة
description: A standing wall stretch for the calf muscles. Helps with ankle mobility and tight lower legs.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it.
Step one foot back with the heel on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

name: وضعية الجسر سيتو باندهاسانا
description: A yoga backbend that strengthens the glutes and opens the chest and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet hip width apart.
Place your arms alongside your body, palms down.
Press through your feet and lift your hips.
Roll your shoulders under and lengthen your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower down slowly.

name: تمدد المقربات
description: A seated stretch for the inner thighs. Improves hip flexibility.
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your ankles and sit tall.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Gently press your elbows on your thighs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

name: تمدد عضلات الفخذ على أربع
description: On all fours you pull one foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. It eases tight quads.
instructions: ابدأ بالارتكاز على يديك وركبتيك مع وضع يديك تحت كتفيك مباشرة وركبتيك تحت وركيك مباشرة.
مد ساقاً واحدة إلى الخلف مع إبقاء الركبة مثنية والقدم مشدودة.
أنزل وركيك ببطء نحو الأرض مع الشعور بتمدد في العضلات الرباعية.
حافظ على هذا الوضع لمدة 20-30 ثانية.
بدّل الساقين وكرر التمدد على الجانب الآخر.

name: تمدد الصدر فوق الرأس
description: Reaching both arms overhead and back opens the front of your chest and shoulders. It is an easy stretch to undo hunched posture.
instructions: Stand tall and interlace your fingers, then raise your arms overhead.
Press your arms slightly back and lift your chest without arching your lower back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

name: تمدد الصدر الخلفي v. 2
description: A back-clasped chest opener that lengthens the pecs and the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands together behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Open your chest and pull your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release and repeat.

name: تمدد الكتف للإحماء بالحبل المطاطي
description: A light band drill that warms up the shoulder joint and loosens the surrounding muscles before training.
instructions: Hold a light band with both hands in front of your thighs, hands wide.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Lift the band overhead and continue back behind your head as far as is comfortable.
Return along the same path to the start.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, widening your grip if it feels tight.

name: ثراستر بالكيتل بيل
description: You squat with a kettlebell at your chest, then stand and press it overhead in one motion. A full body move for legs and shoulders.
instructions: ابدأ بالوقوف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين وإمساك كيتل بيل أمام صدرك بكلتا يديك مع توجيه راحتي يديك نحو بعضهما.
انزل إلى وضعية السكوات عن طريق ثني ركبتيك ودفع وركيك إلى الخلف مع الحفاظ على رفع صدرك واستقامة ظهرك.
عند وصولك إلى أسفل السكوات، ادفع بقوة عبر كعبيك للوقوف مع دفع الكيتل بيل فوق رأسك في الوقت نفسه.
ثبت ذراعيك في أعلى الحركة مع مد مرفقيك بالكامل.
أنزل الكيتل بيل عائداً إلى وضع البداية بعكس الحركة مع ثني مرفقيك وإنزال الوزن عائداً إلى صدرك.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: ثراستر بالكيتل بيل بذراع واحدة
description: A front squat into an overhead press with one kettlebell. It combines legs and shoulders in one flowing move.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder with one hand in the rack position.
Squat down with your chest up and elbow close.
Drive up through your legs.
Use that momentum to press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, repeat, then switch arms.

name: وندميل بالكيتل بيل
description: With a kettlebell held overhead, you push your hips out and reach down toward your foot. Builds shoulder stability, flexibility and core strength.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين مع إمساك كيتل بيل بيدك اليمنى فوق رأسك.
أدر قدمك اليسرى إلى الخارج حوالي 45 درجة وحافظ على بقاء قدمك اليمنى متجهة إلى الأمام.
انحنِ بجذعك إلى الجانب الأيسر مع إبقاء ذراعك اليمنى ممدودة فوق رأسك ونظرك على الكيتل بيل.
أنزل جذعك إلى أقصى ما يمكنك مع إبقاء ذراعك اليمنى مستقيمة وذراعك اليسرى ممدودة إلى الجانب.
توقف لحظة، ثم عد إلى وضع البداية عن طريق الدفع عبر قدمك اليمنى وشد العضلات المائلة.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب ثم بدّل الجانبين.

name: وندميل مزدوج بالكيتل بيل
description: Holding two kettlebells, you hinge sideways with one overhead. It trains the obliques, shoulders and hips.
instructions: قف مع مباعدة قدميك بعرض الكتفين مع إمساك كيتل بيل بيدك اليمنى.
مد ذراعك اليمنى فوق رأسك مع إبقاء نظرك على الكيتل بيل.
أدر قدمك اليسرى 45 درجة إلى اليسار وقدمك اليمنى 90 درجة إلى اليمين.
انحنِ من الخصر إلى اليسار مع إبقاء ذراعك اليمنى ممدودة فوق رأسك.
أنزل الكيتل بيل نحو الأرض مع الوصول نحو قدمك اليسرى.
توقف لحظة، ثم شد عضلات جذعك وادفع عبر قدمك اليمنى للعودة إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب ثم بدّل الجانبين.

name: ضغط بالكيتل بيل
description: A push-up with your hands on kettlebell handles for a deeper range of motion. It builds the chest and arms.
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Extend your legs into a plank position.
Lower your chest between the handles with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up until your arms are straight and repeat.

name: جلوس من الاستلقاء بالكيتل بيل
description: A sit-up holding a kettlebell for extra resistance on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a kettlebell at your chest.
Brace your core.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep the kettlebell close to you.
Lower slowly back down.

name: ديدلفت بساق واحدة بالكيتل بيل
description: A balance-focused hip hinge on one leg with a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge forward at the hips while extending the free leg back.
Lower the kettlebell toward the floor with a flat back.
Keep your hips level and your standing knee slightly bent.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.

name: خطوة سكوات جانبية بالكيتل بيل
description: Stepping sideways into a squat while holding a kettlebell at your chest. It works the thighs and hips.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Step out to the side and sit back into a squat.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels and bring your feet together.
Alternate directions or complete all steps on one side before switching.

name: اندفاع أمامي بالكيتل بيل
description: A lunge stepping forward while holding a kettlebell, working the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs for the set.

name: اندفاع جانبي بالكيتل بيل
description: A lateral lunge holding a kettlebell, working glutes, quads and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Take a big step to the side.
Sit back into that hip while keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

name: سوينغ بذراع واحدة بالكيتل بيل
description: A hip-driven swing with one hand on a kettlebell. It builds explosive posterior chain power.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let the arm stay relaxed; the hips do the work.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again. Switch hands after your set.

name: مشي المزارع بالكيتل بيل
description: Walking while carrying a heavy kettlebell in each hand. It builds grip, posture and core stability.
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in each hand and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and brace your core.
Walk forward in controlled steps.
Keep the kettlebells from swinging.
Walk for a set distance or time, then set them down carefully.

name: مشي المزارع بالكيتل بيل بذراع واحدة
description: Walk while carrying a kettlebell in one hand. It builds grip and demands a strong trunk to stay upright.
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders level.
Walk with steady steps without leaning to the loaded side.
Walk for a set distance or time.
Switch hands and repeat.

name: كلين بذراع واحدة بالكيتل بيل
description: Pulling a kettlebell from the floor to the shoulder with one arm. It trains explosive hip power and coordination.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back slightly between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around so it lands softly in the rack position.
Lower it back down under control, repeat, then switch arms.

name: كلين وضغط بذراع واحدة بالكيتل بيل
englishName: kettlebell single arm clean and press
description: A clean followed by an overhead press with one kettlebell. It links hip power with shoulder strength.
instructions: Hinge and swing the kettlebell back, then clean it to your shoulder.
Settle into a stable rack position with your core tight.
Bend your knees slightly, then press the bell straight overhead.
Lock out your elbow with your biceps near your ear.
Lower it to your shoulder, then to the floor. Switch arms after your set.

name: سناتش بالكيتل بيل
description: Swinging a kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one motion. It builds power through the whole body.
instructions: Stand over the kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Punch your hand through to catch it overhead with a straight arm.
Lower it back under control and repeat, then switch arms.

name: اندفاع أمامي وضغط بالكيتل بيل
description: A forward lunge combined with an overhead press of a kettlebell. It trains legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder in the rack position.
Step forward into a lunge.
As you push back up, press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower the bell to your shoulder as you step back.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

name: سلينغشوت واقفاً بالكيتل بيل
description: Passing a kettlebell around your body in circles while standing. It works the shoulders, core and grip.
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands.
Pass it behind your back from one hand to the other.
Bring it around to the front and pass it again.
Keep your hips steady and your core tight.
Reverse direction halfway through your set.

name: جلوس من الاستلقاء بذراع واحدة بالكيتل بيل
description: A sit-up while holding a kettlebell overhead with one arm. It adds shoulder stability to an abdominal move.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a kettlebell held straight up in one hand.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and your arm locked.
Curl up and sit all the way to standing or upright.
Control your descent back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: تجديف الكتف الخلفي بالكيتل بيل
description: A bent-over row with elbows flared to hit the rear shoulders. It builds upper back and posture muscles.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Let the weights hang below your chest.
Pull your elbows out wide and up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: تجديف منحني بالكيتل بيل
description: A bent-over row using a kettlebell. It trains the lats and mid back.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the kettlebell toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: بول أوفر بذراع مثنية بالكيتل بيل مع ثني الركبتين
englishName: kettlebell bent arm pullover with knees bent
description: A floor pullover with a kettlebell and bent knees. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with elbows slightly bent.
Lower it back over your head, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Keep your lower back close to the floor.
Pull it back over your chest and repeat.

name: ضغط الألماس
description: A narrow push-up variation with the hands close together, putting extra load on the triceps and inner chest.
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back close to your ribs.
Pause briefly just above your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.

name: ثراستر بالدمبل بذراع واحدة
description: A squat into an overhead press with a single dumbbell, training the legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder with one hand and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you sink into the next squat.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: ثراستر بالكيتل بيل بذراع واحدة
description: A kettlebell squat-to-press combo done with one arm that works the legs, shoulders and core in one flow.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your torso upright and elbow close to your body.
Stand up powerfully through your heels.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you rise, finishing with a straight arm.
Lower it back to the rack and go into the next squat.
Switch arms after your set.

name: كلين وجيرك بالكيتل بيل
description: A kettlebell version of the classic lift: swing it to the shoulder, then drive it overhead with a leg push.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge to grab it.
Swing it back between your legs, then drive your hips forward.
Pull the bell up and guide it into the rack position at your shoulder.
Dip slightly with your knees, then explode up.
Punch the kettlebell overhead and lock out your arm.
Lower it back to the rack, then to the floor with control. Switch sides.

name: كلين بذراع واحدة بالكيتل بيل
description: A powerful hip-driven pull that brings a kettlebell from the floor to the rack position on one shoulder.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge at the hips to grab the handle.
Hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and pull the bell close to your body.
Rotate your hand around the bell so it lands softly in the rack at your shoulder.
Stand tall with your elbow tucked in.
Lower the bell back down with control and switch arms.

name: بنش برس مائل للأعلى بالحبل المطاطي
description: An incline press using a band for resistance, targeting the upper chest and front shoulders.
instructions: Set an incline bench and anchor a band behind it or under the bench.
Sit back with the band handles at chest level.
Brace your core and keep your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles up and slightly forward until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to the start, feeling the band pull.
Keep your wrists straight throughout.

name: كيك باك بالكابل بذراع واحدة منحنياً
englishName: cable bent over single arm kickback
description: A one-arm cable kickback that isolates the triceps with constant tension.
instructions: Set a low pulley with a single handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Hold the handle with your elbow bent at your side, upper arm parallel to the floor.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow back.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: درَغ كيرل على السميث
description: A biceps curl where the bar is dragged up along the body, keeping the load on the biceps and reducing shoulder swing.
instructions: Stand close to the smith bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang at arm length against your thighs.
Pull your elbows back and drag the bar up along your torso.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar along the same line with control.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning back.

name: جود مورنينغ سكوات
description: A combo of a hip hinge and a squat that warms up and strengthens the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Come back up to standing.
Bend your knees and sink into a squat with your chest tall.
Stand up and repeat the hinge, then the squat.
Keep your core braced and your weight over your mid-foot.

name: بيربي سكوات
description: A burpee with a squat finish that raises your heart rate and works the whole body.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest down, then press back up.
Jump your feet forward to your hands.
Stand and finish with a bodyweight squat before the next rep.

name: اندفاع قطري
description: A lunge stepped out at an angle that trains the legs and hips in a different plane, with a quick, springy pace.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot out diagonally, about 45 degrees away from you.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, keeping your chest up.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate legs each rep.
Keep your front knee pointing the same way as your toes.

name: جسر الصدر
description: A bridge-like drill that opens the upper back and shoulders while rotating the spine.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and one hand behind you.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Reach your free arm up and over, rotating your chest toward the ceiling.
Open your chest as far as feels comfortable.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides.

name: تمدد الأرداف جالساً v. 2
description: A seated figure-four stretch that lengthens the glutes and outer hip.
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with your back tall.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Keep your back straight and lean your chest forward slowly.
Feel the stretch in the glute of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

name: لف الورك الديناميكي 90 90
description: A flowing hip rotation drill that moves the hips through internal and external rotation.
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, feet wide.
Lean back a little and support yourself with your hands.
Rotate both knees to one side so they drop toward the floor.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your movements slow and controlled.
Continue for 10-12 reps per side.

name: مد اليد عبر الجسم
description: A quadruped drill that threads one arm under the body to free up the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Slide one arm under your body, palm up, reaching across.
Let your shoulder and head lower toward the floor.
Hold briefly, then pull the arm back.
Reach it up toward the ceiling, following with your eyes.
Repeat, then switch sides.

name: تمدد الكنبة
description: A deep kneeling stretch with the back foot raised, aimed at the thighs and hip flexors.
instructions: Kneel facing away from a wall or couch with one shin up against it.
Place your other foot flat on the floor in front in a lunge.
Squeeze your glute and tuck your pelvis under.
Lift your torso upright until you feel the stretch in the front of your rear thigh.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
Switch legs.

name: من وضعية الطفل إلى الكوبرا
description: A yoga flow that moves from a resting child pose into a gentle backbend, mobilising the spine.
instructions: Start in child pose, knees apart, arms stretched forward.
Shift forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Slide forward and press into your hands to lift your chest into cobra.
Keep your hips down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a few breaths.
Push back into child pose and repeat.

name: تمدد الظهرية العريضة على المقعد على الركبتين
description: A kneeling stretch with the arms on a bench that opens the lats and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench and place both elbows on top of it.
Keep your hands together or hold a light stick.
Sit your hips back and let your chest sink toward the floor.
Keep your lower back relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Come back up carefully.

name: تمدد الجسم
description: A kneeling lean-back that stretches and strengthens the front of the thighs and the core.
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your body upright.
Cross your arms or put your hands on your hips.
Squeeze your glutes and lean back from the knees as one straight line.
Go back as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up to the start.
Keep your hips forward.

name: سكوات بوزن الجسم مع رفع الكعبين
description: A squat with the heels raised on a small platform, shifting more work to the quads and allowing a deeper knee bend.
instructions: Place your heels on a small plate or wedge, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knees and sink down with your chest tall.
Let your knees travel forward over your toes.
Drive back up through your whole foot.
Keep your core tight throughout.

name: كوساك سكوات بالدمبل
description: A side-to-side squat that trains the legs and loads the inner thighs through a big range of motion.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with a wide stance.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Sit deep with your chest up and the straight leg's toes pointing up.
Push through the bent leg to return to the center.
Move into the other side.
Alternate sides with control.

name: رفع السمانة مع ثبات السكوات بالدمبل
description: A calf raise done from a held squat position, mixing calf work with leg endurance.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and sink into a half squat.
Keep your chest tall and weight over your feet.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your heels slowly without standing up.
Stay in the squat for the full set.

name: مجموعة سكوات واندفاع وقفز بالدمبل
description: A leg-burning chain of squat, lunge and jump with dumbbells for strength and conditioning.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Do a squat and stand back up.
Step into a lunge on each leg.
Finish with a jump, landing softly with bent knees.
Continue the chain without putting the weights down.
Rest, then repeat the sequence.

name: صعود المقعد مع رفع الركبة بالدمبل
englishName: dumbbell step up with knee raise
description: A loaded step-up that finishes with a knee drive, working the legs and balance.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand facing a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel and step up.
Lift the other knee toward your chest at the top.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: كيك باك بالكابل بقبضة محايدة
description: A cable kickback with palms facing in, isolating the triceps.
instructions: Set a low cable with a neutral grip handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Pin your upper arm against your side.
Hold the handle with your palm facing in.
Extend your elbow back until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

name: كيك باك بالكابل بقبضة محايدة بذراع واحدة منحنياً بالحبل
englishName: cable bent over single arm neutral grip kickback with rope attachment
description: A one-arm rope kickback that works the triceps with steady cable tension.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end with a neutral grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and tucked in.
Straighten your elbow and pull the rope back.
Squeeze at the end of the motion.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

name: فصل الحبل المطاطي
description: A simple band pull-apart to strengthen the back of the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at chest height, arms straight.
Keep your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

name: تجديف منحني بذراع واحدة بالحبل المطاطي
englishName: resistance band one arm bent over row
description: A single-arm row using a resistance band, working the lats and mid-back.
instructions: Stand on the band with a staggered stance and hinge forward.
Hold the handle in one hand with your arm extended.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

name: تجديف منحني بقبضة محايدة بالحبل المطاطي
englishName: resistance band bent over neutral grip row
description: A two-handed bent-over band row with palms facing in, hitting the lats and mid-back.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward.
Hold the handles with a neutral grip, arms straight.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Pull both handles toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

name: ضغط بالحبل المطاطي
description: A push-up with a band across your back that adds resistance at the top of the movement.
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your hands.
Get into a plank position with your body straight.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up against the band until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.
Lower slowly for the next rep.

name: رفع وقطع بالدمبل على ركبة واحدة
englishName: dumbbell half kneeling lift and chop
description: A diagonal dumbbell pattern from a half kneeling stance that trains rotational core strength.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a dumbbell with both hands.
Start with the weight by your low outside hip.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Chop it back down along the same line.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: قطع بالحبل المطاطي على ركبة واحدة
description: A band chop from a half kneeling position, building core stability and rotation.
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel on one knee side-on to the anchor.
Hold the band with both hands near your high shoulder.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

name: بايسبس كيرل إلى ضغط الكتف بالدمبل واقفاً
englishName: dumbbell standing biceps curl to shoulder press
description: A compound arm move that links a biceps curl into an overhead press.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms to face forward at the top of the curl.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders, then down to your sides.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.

name: تجديف بذراع واحدة واقفاً بالحبل المطاطي
description: A standing one-arm row with a band to train the lats and mid-back.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand facing it.
Hold the band in one hand with your arm extended.
Step back until there is tension and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

name: سحب بذراعين مستقيمتين واقفاً بالحبل المطاطي
description: A straight-arm band pulldown that isolates the lats.
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the ends with arms extended in front of you.
Stand with a slight forward lean and a braced core.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull the band down in an arc until your hands reach your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.

name: ضغط عسكري بالدمبل على ركبة واحدة
description: An overhead dumbbell press from a half kneeling stance, adding core and hip stability.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.
Switch your lead leg halfway through or on the next set.

name: كيك باك بالكابل بقبضة محايدة منحنياً بالحبل
englishName: cable bent over neutral grip kickback with rope attachment
description: A rope kickback with both arms that targets the triceps through full extension.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold both ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows and spread the rope slightly at the end.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.

name: صعود الصندوق بوزن الجسم
description: A basic step-up onto a box that builds leg and hip strength and single-leg control.
instructions: Stand facing a step box with feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through your heel to step up and stand tall.
Bring the other foot up to meet it.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch the lead leg.

name: تمدد القطة والبقرة
description: A gentle spinal flow between arching and rounding the back to loosen the spine.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and drop your belly, lifting your chest and tailbone into cow.
Exhale and round your back toward the ceiling into cat.
Tuck your chin and pull your belly in.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 10-12 breaths.

name: صد الملاكمة
description: A defensive boxing guard that covers your head and body from incoming punches.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with feet staggered and knees slightly bent.
Bring your fists up to your cheeks with elbows tucked in.
Keep your chin down.
Raise your forearms to cover your face as if blocking a punch.
Bring your elbows together to cover your ribs.
Reset to your guard and repeat.

name: جاب الملاكمة (مع كيس الملاكمة)
description: A quick straight punch with your lead hand thrown at a heavy bag.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag with your hands up.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the bag.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down on impact.
Keep your rear hand guarding your chin.
Snap the punch back to your guard right away.
Stay light on your feet and repeat.

name: كروس يمين الملاكمة (مع كيس الملاكمة)
description: A powerful straight punch from the rear hand, driven by the hips and thrown at a bag.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the bag.
Rotate your shoulder and keep your chin tucked.
Keep your lead hand up to guard.
Snap back to your stance and repeat.

name: هوك يمين الملاكمة (مع كيس الملاكمة)
description: A curved punch thrown from the rear hand, rotating the torso to hit the side of the bag.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Rotate your hips and torso to swing the fist in an arc.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Hit the bag and keep your left hand guarding.
Return to your guard and repeat.

name: ركلة أمامية للأسفل في الكيك بوكسينغ (مع كيس الملاكمة)
englishName: front groin kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
description: A straight front kick thrown low at a bag, training leg power and balance.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag with hands up.
Lift your rear knee toward your chest.
Extend your leg and drive the ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly to stay balanced.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Return to your stance and switch sides.

name: ركلة أمامية في الكيك بوكسينغ (مع كيس الملاكمة)
description: A front push kick aimed at a bag that builds leg power, balance and hip flexibility.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Lift your rear knee up in front of you.
Extend your leg and push your heel or ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly and keep your guard up.
Pull the leg back to bend it.
Plant your foot and switch sides.

name: ركلة أمامية سريعة في الكيك بوكسينغ (مع كيس الملاكمة)
englishName: front snap kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
description: A quick snapping front kick at a bag that trains speed and control in the thigh and hip.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the bag with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

name: ركلة هوك في الكيك بوكسينغ (مع كيس الملاكمة)
description: A roundhouse-style kick that swings in an arc into the bag, building hip rotation and power.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out to the side.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc.
Hit the bag with the top of your foot or shin.
Keep your hands up and your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

name: جاب الملاكمة (مع شريك)
description: A straight lead-hand punch thrown at a partner holding pads, working speed and accuracy.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Throw your lead hand straight to the pad.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down.
Retract your hand quickly to your guard.
Keep your feet light and repeat.

name: أبركت يسار الملاكمة (مع شريك)
description: A rising punch with the left hand thrown to a partner's pad, using leg and hip drive.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Rotate your hips as you bring your left fist up in a tight arc.
Hit the pad with the palm facing you.
Reset your guard.

name: كروس يمين الملاكمة (مع شريك)
description: A straight rear-hand punch with hip rotation, thrown to a partner's pad.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the pad.
Keep your chin tucked and left hand up.
Snap back to your stance.

name: هوك يمين الملاكمة (مع شريك)
description: A curved rear-hand punch thrown to a partner's pad, using torso rotation for power.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad out to the side.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your right elbow and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing the fist in an arc into the pad.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Return to your guard.

name: أبركت يمين الملاكمة (مع شريك)
description: A rising rear-hand punch thrown to a partner's pad, driven by the legs and hips.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and rotate your hips.
Bring your right fist up in a tight arc to the pad.
Keep your left hand guarding.
Reset your stance.

name: ركلة أمامية في الكيك بوكسينغ (مع شريك)
description: A front push kick aimed at a partner's pad, training leg power, balance and timing.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad at body height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Raise your rear knee in front of you.
Extend your leg and push the ball of your foot into the pad.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Switch sides after your reps.

name: ركلة ركبة أمامية في الكيك بوكسينغ (مع شريك)
description: A knee strike driven forward into a partner's pad, working the thighs, hips and core.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at waist height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Drive your rear knee up and forward into the pad.
Rise slightly onto the toes of your standing foot.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower the leg and switch sides.

name: ركلة أمامية سريعة في الكيك بوكسينغ (مع شريك)
description: A quick snapping front kick into a partner's pad that trains speed and leg control.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at body height.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the pad with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

name: ركلة هوك في الكيك بوكسينغ (مع شريك)
description: A roundhouse-style hook kick delivered to a partner's pad, building hip rotation and power.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad to the side.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc into the pad.
Keep your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

name: تدليك الموترة للفافة العريضة
description: A foam roller release for the outer front hip, easing tightness around the tensor fasciae latae.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the front of your outer hip.
Support yourself with your forearm and opposite foot.
Slowly roll up and down a few inches.
Pause on tender spots for a few seconds.
Breathe slowly and keep the movement gentle.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

name: تدليك الحرقفية القطنية
description: A roller or ball release for the deep hip flexor area at the front of the pelvis.
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under the front of one hip, just inside the hip bone.
Support your weight on your forearms.
Shift your weight gently over the roller.
Roll slowly a small distance up and down.
Pause on tight spots while breathing deeply.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

name: تدليك أسفل الظهر بالكرة
description: Rolling a small ball under your lower back to release tight spots and loosen the muscles beside the spine.
instructions: Lie on your back with a small ball under one side of your lower back.
Bend your knees and keep your feet flat on the floor.
Shift your weight slowly so the ball rolls along the muscle next to the spine.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths, then move on.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable, never on the spine itself.

name: تمدد الكتاب المفتوح
description: A lying rotation that opens the chest and mid back, good for thoracic mobility and tight shoulders.
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your knees together and lift the top arm up and over.
Rotate your chest open toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return the arm and repeat, then switch sides.

name: دوران خارجي بالأنبوب
description: Using a light pipe to practice rotating the shoulders outward, building control and range for overhead lifts.
instructions: Hold a PVC pipe in both hands with your elbows tucked at your sides and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pinned and rotate the pipe so one hand moves outward.
Return to the start and rotate the other way.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down and your wrists straight.
Continue alternating for the planned reps.

name: تمدد الكتف الأمامي بالأنبوب
description: A pipe-assisted stretch for the lats, shoulders and wrists that helps you get into a comfortable front rack position.
instructions: Stand tall holding a PVC pipe across your upper chest in a front rack grip.
Lift your elbows forward and up as high as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and your lower back from arching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the elbows and repeat.

name: جود مورنينغ بالأنبوب
description: A hip hinge drill with a light pipe on your back, teaching you to bend at the hips with a flat spine.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a PVC pipe across your upper back.
Soften your knees slightly and push your hips straight back.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep the pipe in contact with your head, upper back and tailbone if you can.

name: ثني الورك بالأنبوب
description: A simple hinge pattern drill using a pipe along your spine to check posture while you bend at the hips.
instructions: Hold a PVC pipe vertically along your spine, one hand at the neck and one at the lower back.
Keep the pipe touching head, upper back and tailbone.
Push your hips back with soft knees and tip forward.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch, then squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep the pipe contact the whole time.

name: سكوات فوق الرأس بالأنبوب
description: A squat with a light pipe held overhead that checks your mobility and trains posture through the whole body.
instructions: Hold a PVC pipe overhead with a wide grip and arms locked out.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders.
Squat down by sitting between your hips, keeping the pipe over your mid-foot.
Go as deep as you can with your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

name: تمرير الأنبوب فوق الرأس
description: Swinging a pipe from the front of your thighs to behind your back to open the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Stand holding a PVC pipe in front of your thighs with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the pipe overhead.
Continue moving it down behind your back as far as comfortable.
Reverse the path back to the front with control.
Widen your grip if the shoulders feel pinched.

name: تبديل صندوق الساق
description: A seated hip rotation drill where you switch both knees from one side to the other, loosening the hips.
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side.
Sit tall and keep your hands on the floor if needed.
Rotate your knees to the other side so the legs swap positions.
Move smoothly without using your hands to push too hard.
Repeat back and forth for the set.

name: ميل الركبتين من جانب لآخر من الاستلقاء
description: A gentle lying rotation that sways your bent knees side to side to loosen the lower back and hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent, feet flat.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Slowly drop both knees to one side as far as is comfortable.
Bring them back to the middle and drop them to the other side.
Move at an easy pace and breathe through each rep.

name: تدليك الدالية الخلفية بالكرة
description: Self-massage with a ball on the back of the shoulder to ease tension in the rear delts.
instructions: Place a small ball between the back of your shoulder and a wall.
Lean in until you feel moderate pressure.
Roll slowly up, down and sideways over the rear deltoid.
Pause on tight spots for a few breaths.
Switch to the other shoulder.

name: حول العالم واقفاً بوزن الجسم (بإسناد الحائط)
englishName: bodyweight standing around the world (wall supported)
description: A standing arm circle against a wall that mobilises the shoulders while keeping your back from compensating.
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet slightly forward.
Start with arms straight down at your sides, palms forward.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and overhead in a wide arc, staying close to the wall.
Lower them back down the same way.
Keep your ribs and head against the wall.

name: ضغط عسكري واقفاً بوزن الجسم (بإسناد الحائط)
description: An unloaded overhead press against a wall to groove a clean path and open the shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall, hands at shoulder height with elbows bent.
Brace your abs so your lower back stays on the wall.
Press your hands straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

name: رفع الساقين المستقيمتين على كرسي القائد
description: A straight leg raise on a captain's chair, lifting your legs in front of you. Works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: اجلس على كرسي الكابتن مع إسناد ظهرك على مسند الظهر وساعديك على وسائد الذراعين.
حافظ على ثبات الجزء العلوي من جسمك واستقامة ظهرك.
شد عضلات بطنك وارفع ساقيك أمامك مع إبقائهما مستقيمتين.
استمر في الرفع حتى تصبح ساقاك موازيتين للأرض أو إلى أعلى مستوى مريح لك.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أنزل ساقيك ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: دوامات الورك
description: Standing hip circles that loosen the hip joints and warm up the pelvis.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Slightly bend your knees.
Move your hips in a large smooth circle, as if drawing it with your belt buckle.
Do several circles one way, then switch direction.
Keep your shoulders still and relaxed.

name: ركلة الساق الأمامية
description: A standing leg swing forward that warms up the hip flexors and hamstrings and challenges your balance.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out for balance or hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Swing the other leg forward and up in a controlled kick, keeping it fairly straight.
Lower it with control without leaning back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

name: ضغط بذراع واحدة (بإسناد الحائط)
description: An easier one-arm push-up using a wall, building the strength and stability needed for the full floor version.
instructions: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place one hand on it at chest height.
Keep your other arm behind your back or at your side.
Bend your elbow to lower your chest toward the wall, body in a straight line.
Press back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: ديدلفت بالحبل المطاطي
description: A hip hinge using a band under your feet for rising tension, working the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and grab it with both hands.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Lower your hands along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep the band close to your body.

name: هامر كيرل واقفاً بالحبل المطاطي
description: A neutral-grip curl against band tension that builds the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

name: كرنش مع لف
description: A crunch with a rotation that adds work for the obliques on top of the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

name: جلوس من الاستلقاء مع ضغط الكتف بقبضة ضيقة بالدمبل
englishName: dumbbell close grip shoulder press sit up
description: A sit-up that finishes with an overhead press, joining core and shoulder work in a single rep.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing in.
Sit up using your abs.
Press the dumbbells overhead at the top.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down slowly.
Keep your feet planted, or anchor them if needed.

name: بلانك أمامي مع رفع الذراع بالدمبل
description: A plank with one arm lifting a dumbbell forward, challenging your core to stay still.
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and keep hips level.
Lift the dumbbell forward in line with your torso.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms for the set.

name: كرنش تاك بالوزن جالساً على الأرض
englishName: weighted seated tuck crunch on floor
description: A seated tuck that brings the knees and chest together while holding a weight, targeting the lower abs.
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a weight at your chest, leaning back slightly with legs extended.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in while bringing your chest forward.
Extend your legs again without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and breathe steadily.

name: كرنش للأعلى بالدمبل
description: A weighted crunch holding a dumbbell at the chest to add resistance for the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell held against your chest.
Brace your abs.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

name: جلوس من الاستلقاء مع لف روسي وضغط الكتف بقبضة ضيقة بالدمبل
englishName: dumbbell russian twist close grip shoulder press sit up
description: A compound core move that links a sit-up, a Russian twist and an overhead press with a dumbbell.
