instructions: Anchor the band low and face away from it, holding the band between your legs.
Step forward until you feel tension, feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your arms relaxed and straight.

name: فلاي مائل للأعلى على الجهاز
description: A machine fly with an incline angle that emphasizes the upper chest. The handles move in a fixed arc.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your upper chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.

name: سحب علوي جانبي بذراع مستقيمة وذراع واحدة
englishName: single arm side straight arm lat pulldown
description: A straight-arm cable pulldown from the side, one arm at a time. It isolates the lats without bending the elbow much.
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with one handle in your hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and slightly angled.
Pull the handle down toward your thigh by squeezing your lat.
Hold briefly.
Let it rise slowly and switch sides after your set.

name: كرنش متقاطع واقفاً
description: A standing crunch that brings your elbow across to the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee and rotate your torso.
Bring the opposite elbow toward that knee.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides for the set.

name: تجديف الكتف الخلفي المائل بالبار
description: A row lying chest-down on an incline bench with elbows flared. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a barbell with a wide grip.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the bar up with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: رفع السمانة واقفاً بالكيتل بيل
description: A standing calf raise holding a kettlebell for resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the balls of your feet on a step if you like.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Rise as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.

name: كلين وضغط بالكيتل بيل
description: Clean a kettlebell to the shoulder and press it overhead. It combines a hip drive with a shoulder press for full-body power.
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and hinge to grip it.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up to your shoulder.
Brace your core and press the bell overhead.
Lock out your arm with the bicep near your ear.
Lower to the shoulder, then back to the floor, and switch sides.

name: كونسنتريشن كيرل بالكيتل بيل
description: A seated one-arm curl with the elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps with a strict path.
instructions: Sit with your legs apart and a kettlebell in one hand.
Rest your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

name: بايسبس كيرل بالكيتل بيل
description: A standard curl holding a kettlebell, which pulls the weight slightly forward of the hand. It builds the biceps and grip.
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands or one.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the kettlebell toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower with control.

name: فلاي على الأرض بالكيتل بيل
description: Lie on the floor and open your arms out with kettlebells, stopping when your elbows touch down. It trains the chest.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides until the elbows touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back up.
Repeat with control.

name: رفع أمامي بالكيتل بيل
description: Lift a kettlebell straight in front of you to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands by the sides of the handle.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the kettlebell to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: تمدد الترايسبس فوق الرأس بالكيتل بيل
description: Hold a kettlebell behind your head and straighten your arms overhead. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns with both hands overhead.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms until they are straight.
Repeat without flaring your elbows.

name: سكل كراشر بالكيتل بيل من الاستلقاء
englishName: kettlebell lying triceps extension skull crusher
description: Lie back and lower a kettlebell toward your forehead, then extend. It builds the triceps with elbows fixed.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Repeat with control.

name: رست كيرل بالكيتل بيل
description: Curl a kettlebell with only your wrists while your forearm rests on your thigh. It builds forearm strength and grip.
instructions: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a kettlebell.
Let your wrist extend downward.
Curl your hand up toward you.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

name: تمدد بذراع واحدة واقفاً بالكيتل بيل
description: Hold a kettlebell overhead in one hand and lower it behind your head. It isolates one triceps at a time.
instructions: Stand tall with a kettlebell held overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending the elbow.
Straighten your arm back to the top.
Switch sides after your set.

name: أرجحة بوزن الجسم
description: A hip hinge swing with your arms moving like a kettlebell swing, but with no weight. It teaches the hip drive and warms up the glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms hanging.
Hinge back at your hips and swing your arms between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and stand tall.
Let your arms float up to chest height.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

name: سكوات قفز من الوقفة الواسعة إلى الوقفة الضيقة
englishName: wide stance jump squat to narrow stance jump squat
description: Jump squats that alternate between a wide and a narrow stance. It builds explosive leg power and gets your heart rate up.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and squat down.
Jump up, bringing your feet together mid-air.
Land softly in a narrow stance and squat.
Jump again, landing back in the wide stance.
Keep your chest up and move at a steady pace.

name: ضغط الماس مائل للأسفل
description: A diamond push-up with your feet raised. It shifts the load toward the triceps and upper chest.
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands close together under your chest.
Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Push back up to straight arms.

name: تجديف منحني مع لف بالتناوب بالكيتل بيل
englishName: kettlebell bent over alternate twist row
description: A bent over kettlebell row with a rotation as you pull. It trains the back and challenges the core.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Row one kettlebell toward your hip.
Rotate your torso slightly as you pull.
Lower the weight and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides for the set.

name: تمدد الترايسبس من الاستلقاء بالبار المتعرج
description: Lie on a bench and lower an EZ bar toward your forehead, then press back up. It builds the triceps with minimal wrist strain.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows from flaring.

name: تمدد الترايسبس فوق الرأس بالكابل العالي وبار مستقيم
englishName: cable high pulley straight bar overhead triceps extension
description: Face away from a high pulley and extend your arms overhead holding a straight bar. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms forward and up.
Return slowly.

name: تمدد الترايسبس بحبال التعليق
description: Lean into suspension straps and straighten your arms from a bent position. It trains the triceps using your body weight.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your arms overhead and elbows bent.
Extend your arms, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause when your arms are straight.
Lower back slowly.

name: بلانك جانبي بالكيتل بيل
description: A side plank holding a kettlebell above you. It builds core and shoulder stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold a kettlebell in your top hand pointing up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

name: رفع السمانة وسكوات أمامي بالكيتل بيل
englishName: kettlebell calf raise and front squat
description: A combo move that pairs a goblet-style front squat with a calf raise at the top, working the legs from hips to ankles.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.
At the top, rise onto your toes for a calf raise.
Lower your heels and repeat with control.

name: مشي السلطعون
description: Walk on hands and feet with your belly facing up, a playful drill that fires up the glutes, triceps and core.
instructions: Sit on the floor, place your hands behind you and lift your hips off the ground.
Keep your hips high and your core braced.
Step with opposite hand and foot to move forward.
Walk for several steps, then go backward.
Keep your head neutral and your arms steady.

name: سكوات مع قطع الخشب بوزن الجسم
description: A squat with a diagonal chopping arm motion that trains the legs and teaches the trunk to rotate with control.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped above one shoulder.
Squat down while chopping your hands diagonally toward the opposite knee.
Rotate through your trunk and let your back foot pivot.
Stand up as you swing your arms back up.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

name: كيرل وضغط وتمدد بالبار
description: A three-part arm combo: curl, press overhead, then lower behind the head for a triceps extension. It works the whole arm in one set.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at thigh level.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders without swinging.
Press it overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Extend, bring the bar back to the front and lower it under control.
Use a light weight to keep your form tidy.

name: كيرل وضغط وتمدد بالدمبل
description: Curl, press and overhead extension chained into one rep with dumbbells, giving the biceps, shoulders and triceps a full workout.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights behind your head.
Extend your arms, then bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders and down to your sides.
Keep your torso still and choose a manageable weight.

name: تنفس بوضعية اللوتس
description: A seated cross-legged breathing practice that calms the mind and lengthens the spine while the hips stay open.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and each foot resting on the opposite thigh if comfortable.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Inhale slowly through your nose and fill your belly and chest.
Exhale slowly and fully.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and breathe steadily for 1-2 minutes.

name: ديدلفت دوراني بالكيتل بيل
description: A hip hinge with a rotation toward the floor, training the glutes and hamstrings while the trunk learns to twist under load.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell in both hands.
Push your hips back and lower the bell toward the outside of one foot.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand and unwind.
Repeat to the same side, then switch.

name: وضعية الكلب بثلاث سيقان
description: Downward dog with one leg lifted behind you. Stretches the back of the legs while building shoulder and hip stability.
instructions: Start in downward dog with hands shoulder-width apart.
Press your hands into the floor and lengthen your spine.
Lift one leg straight up behind you, keeping your hips square.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Lower and switch legs.

name: وضعية تشاتورانغا
description: A low plank where the elbows are bent back by your ribs. Builds strength in the arms, chest and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your wrists under your shoulders.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower to elbow height.
Keep your body in one line and your elbows near your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

name: وضعية الجثة شافاسانا
description: The classic resting pose at the end of practice. Lets the body relax fully.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and slightly apart.
Let your arms rest by your sides with palms up.
Close your eyes and let your whole body soften.
Breathe slowly for 2-5 minutes.
Roll to your side and sit up gently.

name: وضعية الحمامة المزدوجة
description: A seated pose with one shin stacked on the other. Opens the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Sit with your legs crossed and stack one shin on top of the other.
Flex your feet to protect your knees.
Sit tall, then hinge forward over your shins.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Swap which leg is on top and repeat.

name: اندفاع عالٍ
description: A deep lunge with the back heel lifted and arms overhead. Strengthens the legs and stretches the hips.
instructions: Step one foot back into a long lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bend your front knee to about 90 degrees over your ankle.
Sweep your arms overhead and stand tall.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Step forward and switch legs.

name: وضعية السحلية
description: A low lunge with both hands inside the front foot. Opens the hips and groin.
instructions: Start in a low lunge with your back knee down or lifted.
Walk your front foot to the outer edge of your mat.
Place both hands inside the front foot.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.

name: اندفاع منخفض
description: A deep lunge stretch that opens the hip flexors and quads.
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

name: تأمل
description: Seated stillness with a tall spine. Calms the mind and trains upright posture.
instructions: Sit comfortably cross-legged, with hips slightly higher than your knees.
Lengthen your spine and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your knees.
Close your eyes and settle into easy breathing.
Stay for 3-10 minutes.

name: تأمل التنفس الواعي
description: A seated practice of following your breath. Lowers tension and trains focus.
instructions: Sit tall in a comfortable position and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your lap.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Breathe out slowly and notice the pause.
Continue for 3-10 minutes.

name: وضعية الجبل
description: The basic standing pose with a tall, balanced posture. A base for most other poses.
instructions: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart.
Spread your toes and press evenly through both feet.
Lengthen your spine and draw your shoulders back and down.
Let your arms hang with palms forward.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.

name: وضعية الجرو
description: A half child's pose with arms reaching forward and hips high. Opens the shoulders and the back.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with your hips over your knees.
Walk your hands forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your hips high above your knees.
Rest your forehead down and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Walk your hands back to return.

name: وضعية الهرم
description: A standing forward fold with one leg back. Deeply stretches the back of the front leg.
instructions: Step one foot back with both feet facing forward.
Keep both legs straight and your hips square.
Hinge forward from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise slowly and switch legs.

name: الكرسي الملتوي
description: A chair squat with a twist. Strengthens the legs while rotating the spine.
instructions: Stand and sink your hips back into a chair pose.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook one elbow outside the opposite knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your knees together.
Untwist and repeat on the other side.

name: وضعية الزاوية الجانبية الملتوية
description: A deep lunge with a twist and the arms stretched wide. Builds leg strength and opens the spine.
instructions: Step into a lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your elbow outside the front knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch sides.

name: وضعية المثلث الملتوي
description: A standing forward bend with a twist. Stretches the back of the legs and rotates the spine.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide, back foot turned slightly.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Place one hand down and reach the other arm up as you twist.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Come up and switch sides.

name: وضعية الرقم أربعة واقفاً
description: A one-leg balance with the ankle crossed over the opposite knee. Stretches the outer hip.
instructions: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one leg.
Cross the other ankle over the standing thigh.
Bend your standing knee and sit your hips back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with a long spine.
Switch legs.

name: نصف الانحناء واقفاً
description: A halfway forward fold with a flat back. Lengthens the back of the legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from your hips and bring your hands to your shins or thighs.
Lengthen your spine until your back is flat.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Roll up slowly to stand.

name: وضعية إدخال الخيط في الإبرة
description: A gentle twist from hands and knees. Loosens the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Slide one arm under your chest and rest your shoulder on the floor.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Return and switch arms.

name: وضعية كيرل النمر
description: From hands and knees, you extend one leg back and curl the knee toward your nose. Works the abs and mobilizes the spine.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine.
Extend one leg behind you and look slightly forward.
Round your back and draw the knee toward your nose.
Extend again and repeat for 6-8 reps.
Switch legs.

name: وضعية الاندفاع بساق ملتوية
description: A lunge with a twist toward the front leg. Opens the hips and spine.
instructions: Step into a low lunge with your back knee down.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist toward the front leg and hook your elbow outside the knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.

name: وضعية المحارب الثالث
description: A one-leg balance with the torso and back leg parallel to the floor. Builds balance and strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg with your arms overhead.
Hinge forward and lift the back leg behind you.
Bring your torso and back leg level with the floor.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your hips square.
Lower and switch legs.

name: وضعية الرأس إلى الركبة الملتوية
description: A seated side bend and twist over one extended leg. Stretches the side body and hamstrings.
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and the other foot against your inner thigh.
Rotate your chest toward the extended leg.
Reach one arm overhead and bend over the leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise and switch sides.

name: ديدلفت سومو بالسلاسل
description: A sumo deadlift with chains hung on the bar, so the load gets heavier as you stand up. It builds the glutes, inner thighs and back.
instructions: Hang chains on a barbell and stand with a wide stance, toes pointed out.
Grip the bar inside your knees with a flat back.
Push the floor away and drive your knees out.
Stand tall as the chains lift and the load increases.
Lock out with your glutes, then lower the bar under control.

name: جود مورنينج بالبار الآمن
description: A hip hinge with a safety squat bar resting on your shoulders, strengthening the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Set the safety bar on your upper back and shoulders and hold the handles.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

name: ديدلفت سومو بالبار والسلاسل
description: Sumo deadlift with chains added to the bar for extra resistance near lockout, hitting the glutes, thighs and back.
instructions: Loop chains over the ends of a barbell and take a wide stance, toes angled out.
Bend down and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push through your feet and stand, with the chains adding load as you rise.
Lock out your hips, then lower the bar with control.

name: وضعية المحارب المعكوس
description: A lunge with a back bend and one arm reaching up. Stretches the side body and strengthens the legs.
instructions: Step into a wide warrior II stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Reach your front arm up and lean back.
Rest your back hand on your leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then switch.

name: وضعية العصا بأربعة أطراف
description: A low plank with elbows hugged by your sides. Builds strength in the arms and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

name: تشاتورانغا بثلاث سيقان
description: A low plank with one leg lifted. Adds a balance challenge to the arms and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank and lift one leg behind you.
Keep your hips level.
Bend your elbows back and lower.
Hold briefly with your body in line.
Press up, lower the leg and switch.

name: تمدد الترايسبس فوق الرأس بالكابل العالي جالساً
englishName: cable seated high pulley overhead tricep extension
description: A seated overhead triceps extension on a high pulley that keeps constant tension on the back of the arms.
instructions: Sit facing away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to extend the handle up.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Keep your torso upright and your upper arms still.

name: وضعية الطفل السعيد
description: Lying on your back and holding your feet with knees wide. Opens the hips and relaxes the lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back and bend your knees toward your chest.
Hold the outsides of your feet.
Open your knees wide toward your armpits.
Rock gently side to side and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Release your feet and rest.

name: هامر بريتشر كيرل بالدمبل
description: A preacher curl with a neutral hammer grip that targets the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with palm facing in, thumb up.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight.
Complete your reps, then switch arms or alternate.

name: نصف سكوات مع مد جانبي
description: A half squat with a side bend that trains the obliques and legs while loosening the trunk.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Sit into a half squat.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
Return to center.
Reach to the other side.
Keep your chest up.

name: قطع الخشب مع اللف الروسي
description: A seated twist with a diagonal chopping arm motion. Works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands together in front of you.
Twist and chop your arms diagonally across your body.
Return to center and chop the other way.
Keep your chest tall and your core tight.

name: رفع أمامي بالكابل بذراع واحدة بقبضة محايدة
englishName: cable single arm neutral grip front raise
description: A one-arm cable front raise with a palm-in grip, giving steady tension to the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley and hold the handle with a neutral grip.
Keep your arm nearly straight and your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

name: رفع أمامي بالدمبل بذراع واحدة بقبضة محايدة
englishName: dumbbell single arm neutral grip front raise
description: A one-arm dumbbell front raise using a hammer grip, targeting the front deltoid with less wrist strain.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side with palm facing in.
Brace your core and keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Avoid swinging, finish all reps and switch arms.

name: رفع الركبة احتفالاً
description: Fast alternating knee drives with arms pumping overhead, a fun cardio drill.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Lower and switch.
Keep a quick, bouncy rhythm.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.

name: جلوس عمودي من الاستلقاء
description: A sit-up performed with the legs raised vertically, which keeps the focus on the abs by taking the hip flexors out of the pull.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up and reach toward your feet.
Pause at the top.
Lower your upper body slowly to the floor.

name: تجديف جالس منخفض بالكابل
description: Seated cable row from a low pulley. You pull the handles to your torso and squeeze the shoulder blades, building the mid back.
instructions: اجلس على الجهاز مع وضع قدميك على مساند القدمين وثني ركبتيك قليلاً.
أمسك المقابض بقبضة علوية مع توجيه راحتي يديك إلى الأسفل.
حافظ على استقامة ظهرك وانحنِ إلى الأمام قليلاً مع الحفاظ على ثني بسيط في مرفقيك.
اسحب المقابض نحو جسمك مع سحب لوحي كتفيك للخلف وللداخل.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة، ثم أعد المقابض ببطء إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: تمرين العصا 1 2
description: A quick footwork drill that builds agility and coordination with fast, light steps.
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Take quick steps in the set pattern, one then two.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms bent and swinging naturally.
Repeat for 20-30 seconds with sharp, light steps.

name: قفز مع لف
description: A jump with a midair trunk rotation that trains explosive leg power and core control.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a slight squat.
Jump up and rotate your hips and feet to one side.
Land softly with bent knees.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep your chest up and land quietly.

name: تمرين كرة الرشاقة
description: A footwork and reaction drill with a ball that sharpens agility, balance and quick direction changes.
instructions: Set up with a ball in front of you in an athletic stance.
Move quickly around or over the ball with short, light steps.
Keep your hips low and eyes up.
Change direction without crossing your feet.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

name: بيربي مع لف
description: A burpee with a trunk rotation on the jump, raising your heart rate while challenging the whole body.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Perform a push-up if you like.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Explode up, rotating your trunk as you jump, and land softly.
Alternate twist directions each rep.

name: تمرين النقاط
description: A fast foot drill over a pattern of dots that builds foot speed, ankle stability and coordination.
instructions: Mark five dots on the floor like the five on a die.
Stand on the balls of your feet next to the pattern.
Hop quickly from dot to dot in your chosen order.
Keep your hops small and your knees soft.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

name: المشي من الكعب إلى أصابع القدم
description: A slow line walk with each heel touching the toes of the other foot, which trains balance and steady stride control.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides.
Place your right heel directly in front of your left toes.
Shift your weight forward and step again with the other foot.
Keep your eyes forward and your core gently braced.
Walk 10-15 steps, then turn around and return.

name: تمرين إل
description: A cone drill run in an L shape that sharpens sprinting, backpedaling and quick cuts.
instructions: Place three cones in an L shape, about 5 yards apart.
Sprint from the start cone to the second and touch it.
Backpedal to the start.
Sprint to the second again, turn around the cone and weave around the third.
Return to the start along the same line.
Stay low through turns.

name: تمرين السلم
description: A footwork drill through an agility ladder that builds quick feet, rhythm and coordination.
instructions: Lay an agility ladder flat on the ground.
Stand at the start in an athletic stance.
Step quickly with both feet into each square, one after another.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms and keep your eyes up.
Jog back and repeat for several rounds.

name: تمرين السلم الجانبي
description: A sideways run through an agility ladder to build lateral speed and foot coordination.
instructions: Stand sideways at the start of an agility ladder.
Step both feet into the first square, one at a time.
Move sideways to the next square with quick steps.
Keep your hips low and your feet light.
Finish the ladder, then repeat facing the other way.

name: تمرين رشاقة بليومتريك
description: A mix of quick hops and direction changes that builds explosive power and agility.
instructions: Set out a few markers within a small area.
Stand in an athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Hop or step quickly between the markers in changing directions.
Land softly with bent knees.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

name: لكمة متقاطعة بتوازن على ساق واحدة
description: Cross punches thrown while balancing on one leg, which trains balance, rotation and core control.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and fists up.
Brace your core.
Throw a cross punch, rotating your hips and shoulders.
Pull your fist back to guard.
Keep your standing foot steady.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: تمرين تي
description: A cone drill in a T shape that trains sprinting, side shuffling and backpedaling.
instructions: Set four cones in a T with the top cones 5 yards apart.
Sprint forward to the center cone and touch it.
Shuffle sideways to the left cone and touch it.
Shuffle across to the right cone, then back to the middle.
Backpedal to the start.
Keep your hips low and feet from crossing.

name: المشي على الحبل المشدود
description: Walking along an imaginary or taped line to train balance and foot control.
instructions: Place a line of tape on the floor or imagine one.
Stand at one end with your arms out for balance.
Walk heel to toe along the line.
Keep your gaze ahead and your core braced.
Turn at the end and walk back.

name: تمدد ديناميكي الجندي الدمية
description: A walking stretch where you kick straight legs up toward outstretched hands, warming up the hamstrings and hips.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Kick one straight leg up toward your hands.
Lower it and step forward.
Kick the other leg up.
Keep your chest upright and walk for about 10 reps per side.

name: تمرين إكس
description: A cone drill in an X pattern that mixes sprints, shuffles and backpedals for agility.
instructions: Set four cones in a square, with a center point.
Sprint diagonally from one corner through the center to the opposite corner.
Shuffle sideways along one edge to the next corner.
Backpedal or sprint diagonally again.
Stay low through turns and repeat.

name: تحية الشمس أ
description: A flowing sequence linking breath and movement. Warms up the whole body.
instructions: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward and step back to plank.
Lower, then press into upward dog and downward dog.
Step forward, rise and return to mountain.
Repeat the flow at a steady pace.

name: تحية الشمس ب
description: A more powerful flow that adds chair pose and warrior I. Builds heat and leg strength.
instructions: Stand in mountain pose and sit into a chair pose with your arms overhead.
Fold forward, step back to plank and flow through chaturanga.
Press to downward dog.
Step forward into warrior I on each side, then flow again.
Link every move to your breath.

name: نصف تحية الشمس
description: A shortened sun salutation that keeps the upright flow. Gently warms the spine and legs.
instructions: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward with a long spine.
Lift halfway up with a flat back.
Fold again and rise up with your arms overhead.
Lower your hands to your heart and repeat.

name: فينياسا
description: A short flow of plank, chaturanga, upward dog and downward dog. Used to link poses together.
instructions: Start in plank pose.
Lower to chaturanga with your elbows by your ribs.
Roll forward into upward dog with an open chest.
Lift your hips to downward dog.
Hold for a breath or two and repeat.

name: تمرين 123 للخلف
description: A cone drill with a set number of steps forward and back to sharpen speed and quick direction changes.
instructions: Set a cone line a few yards apart.
Sprint to the first cone and touch it, then back to the start.
Sprint to the second cone and back.
Go to the third cone and back.
Stay low when turning.
Rest, then repeat.

name: تمرين البالون
description: A playful balance and leg drill where you keep a balloon in the air using quick footwork and small jumps.
instructions: Toss a balloon into the air in an open space.
Stay on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Move under the balloon and tap it up.
Use small hops to reach it.
Keep it up for 30-60 seconds.

name: تمرين الأقماع
description: A cone run that builds acceleration, cutting speed and agility.
instructions: Place several cones in a pattern a few yards apart.
Start in an athletic stance.
Sprint or shuffle around the cones in order.
Plant and cut with your hips low.
Finish the course, rest, then go again.

name: ديدلفت بزجاجة بوزن إضافي
description: A light deadlift holding a bottle in each hand. A good way to learn the hip hinge.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Lower the bottles along your legs to mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

name: ركض على شكل رقم
description: A run in a figure-eight around two cones, which builds agility, balance and quick turns.
instructions: Set two cones about 5 yards apart.
Start next to one cone in an athletic stance.
Run a figure-eight around both cones.
Lean into the turns and keep your hips low.
Run for 20-30 seconds, then change direction.

name: قفز الحواجز العالية ثم عدو وتغيير اتجاه
englishName: high hurdle jump to sprint and cut
description: Jump over a high hurdle, land and sprint into a sharp cut, training explosive power and reactive agility.
instructions: Stand facing a high hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump over it, tucking your knees.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sprint forward right away.
Plant and cut sharply to one side.
Walk back and repeat, alternating cut directions.

name: تحرك جانبي مع شريك
description: A mirror drill where you shuffle sideways in response to a partner, training lateral quickness and reaction.
instructions: Face a partner about 2 yards away in an athletic stance.
Have your partner move left or right.
Shuffle sideways to mirror them without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and chest up.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then swap roles.

name: ضغط بالاستلقاء على الأرض
description: A push-up that starts from lying flat on the floor each rep, so every rep begins from a dead stop and builds pressing strength.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Push your body up into a straight plank.
Lower yourself all the way down until your chest rests on the floor.
Relax briefly, then push up again.

name: تقريب الورك من الاستلقاء الجانبي (يسار)
description: A lying leg lift that trains the inner thigh of the left leg.
instructions: Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

name: تقريب الورك من الاستلقاء الجانبي (يسار)
description: A lying leg lift that trains the inner thigh of the left leg.
instructions: Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

name: جسر بساق واحدة مع مد الساق الأخرى (يسار)
englishName: single leg bridge with outstretched leg (left)
description: A bridge on one leg with the other leg stretched out, to strengthen the glutes and hamstrings and test hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your left leg straight out.
Drive through your right heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and switch legs.

name: ثبات جسر الأرداف بساق مستقيمة واحدة (يسار)
englishName: single straight leg glute bridge hold (left)
description: A glute bridge held with the left leg extended straight. Builds one-sided glute strength and pelvic control.
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Straighten your left leg in line with your torso.
Press through the right heel to lift your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your hips level.
Lower slowly.

name: نقر أصابع القدم من الاستلقاء
description: From a tabletop position, alternate lowering a foot to tap the floor while keeping the lower back steady.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
Bring it back to tabletop.
Alternate legs with control.

name: نقر أصابع القدم من الاستلقاء
description: From a tabletop position, alternate lowering a foot to tap the floor while keeping the lower back steady.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
Bring it back to tabletop.
Alternate legs with control.

name: كرنش من الاستلقاء (ساقان مستقيمتان)
description: A crunch with straight legs on the floor that trains the upper abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

name: كرنش من الاستلقاء (ساقان مستقيمتان)
description: A crunch with straight legs on the floor that trains the upper abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

name: نصف سكوات مع مد جانبي
description: A half squat with a side bend that trains the obliques and legs while loosening the trunk.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Sit into a half squat.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
Return to center.
Reach to the other side.
Keep your chest up.

name: اندفاع منخفض
description: A deep lunge stretch that opens the hip flexors and quads.
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

name: اندفاع منخفض (يسار)
description: A deep lunge stretch on the left side that opens the hip flexors and quads.
instructions: Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

name: اندفاع منخفض (يسار)
description: A deep lunge stretch on the left side that opens the hip flexors and quads.
instructions: Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

name: رفع الركبة احتفالاً
description: Fast alternating knee drives with arms pumping overhead, a fun cardio drill.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Lower and switch.
Keep a quick, bouncy rhythm.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.

name: خطوة جانبية مع تجديف الكتف الخلفي
description: A side step paired with a rowing motion that works the rear shoulders and upper back while elevating your pulse.
instructions: Stand in a slight squat with your arms out in front.
Step to the side.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return your arms forward as you step back.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

name: خطوة جانبية مع تجديف الكتف الخلفي
description: A side step paired with a rowing motion that works the rear shoulders and upper back while elevating your pulse.
instructions: Stand in a slight squat with your arms out in front.
Step to the side.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return your arms forward as you step back.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

name: ركلة أمامية
description: A dynamic kick that warms up the hamstrings and hip flexors and builds coordination.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Lower it under control.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your torso upright.

name: رفع الذراعين مع المشي في مكانه
description: Stepping in place while raising your arms, a gentle cardio drill.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Lower them as you continue.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

name: رفع الذراعين مع المشي في مكانه
description: Stepping in place while raising your arms, a gentle cardio drill.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Lower them as you continue.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

name: كرنش مع لف v. 2
description: A crunch with a rotation to bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides for your reps.

name: سحب علوي مع خطوة للخلف
description: A step back with a downward arm pull that fires up the lats and legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms overhead.
Step one foot back.
Pull your elbows down and in as if doing a pulldown.
Return your arms and foot to start.
Alternate legs at a steady pace.

name: ثبات هايبر إكستنشن من الانبطاح
description: A prone hold that lifts the chest and legs, building lower back endurance.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
Keep your neck neutral.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

name: ثبات هايبر إكستنشن من الانبطاح
description: A prone hold that lifts the chest and legs, building lower back endurance.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
Keep your neck neutral.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

name: ركلة الضفدع بالتناوب من الاستلقاء
description: A prone move where you alternate kicking each bent leg up, to work the glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms under your forehead.
Bend one knee to 90 degrees with the sole toward the ceiling.
Lift that thigh off the floor by squeezing the glute.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips on the floor.

name: ركلة الضفدع من الاستلقاء
description: A prone move where both knees bend outward like a frog and kick up, to work the glutes.
instructions: Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: ركلة الضفدع بالتناوب من الاستلقاء
description: A prone move where you alternate kicking each bent leg up, to work the glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms under your forehead.
Bend one knee to 90 degrees with the sole toward the ceiling.
Lift that thigh off the floor by squeezing the glute.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips on the floor.

name: ركلة الضفدع من الاستلقاء
description: A prone move where both knees bend outward like a frog and kick up, to work the glutes.
instructions: Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: سحب البلانك الجانبي
description: A side plank with a pulling arm motion, to build core stability and shoulder strength.
instructions: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Reach your top arm overhead.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: لكمة مع خطوة للأمام
description: A shadow-boxing drill pairing a forward step with a punch for cardio and coordination.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with fists up.
Step forward with your lead foot.
Throw a punch as you step.
Return to your stance.
Alternate sides and keep a steady rhythm.

name: لكمة مع خطوة للأمام
description: A shadow-boxing drill pairing a forward step with a punch for cardio and coordination.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with fists up.
Step forward with your lead foot.
Throw a punch as you step.
Return to your stance.
Alternate sides and keep a steady rhythm.

name: ضغط بالاستلقاء على الأرض
description: A push-up that starts from lying flat on the floor each rep, so every rep begins from a dead stop and builds pressing strength.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Push your body up into a straight plank.
Lower yourself all the way down until your chest rests on the floor.
Relax briefly, then push up again.

name: سحب للداخل (على كرة التوازن)
description: Hands on the floor and feet on a stability ball, you pull the ball toward your chest. Works the abs and hip flexors while challenging balance.
instructions: ابدأ بالجلوس على كرة التوازن مع وضع قدميك على الأرض وثني ركبتيك بزاوية 90 درجة.
ضع يديك على جانبي كرة التوازن للدعم.
شد عضلات بطنك ودحرج وركيك ببطء إلى الأمام مع تقريب ركبتيك نحو صدرك.
توقف لحظة في أعلى الحركة ثم مد ساقيك ببطء عائدتين إلى وضع البداية.
كرر الحركة للعدد المطلوب.

name: تجديف جالس منخفض بالكابل بمقبض في
englishName: cable low seated row with v bar
description: A seated cable row with a V handle and a neutral grip. It builds the mid back and lats.
instructions: Sit at the low pulley, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and hold the V bar.
Sit tall with your chest up and arms straight.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, keeping your torso still.
Extend your arms slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.

name: ضم البطن
description: A knee raise on a vertical knee-raise station: forearms on the pads, back against the pad, knees drawn up toward the chest. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the backrest, legs hanging.
Brace your core and keep your upper body still.
Raise your knees toward your chest, curling your pelvis slightly at the top.
Pause briefly, then lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the planned reps.

name: ديدلفت بالبار من الكتل
description: A deadlift with the bar raised on blocks, which shortens the range of motion and lets you lift heavier.
instructions: Set the bar on blocks or a raised platform.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

name: تجديف الكتف الخلفي بالكابل (بار متوازٍ)
description: A cable row with a parallel bar that targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Sit facing a low cable with a parallel bar attachment.
Hold the handles with your elbows flared.
Lean back slightly with a straight spine.
Pull the handles toward your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

name: سحب بالكابل بذراعين مستقيمتين v. 2
description: A straight-arm pulldown variation that isolates the lats by keeping the elbows nearly straight.
instructions: Stand facing a high cable and grab the bar with straight arms.
Hinge slightly at the hips.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.

name: ركلة الحمار بجهاز سميث
description: A kick-back using the Smith machine bar under the foot, to target the glutes.
instructions: Set the bar of the Smith machine at a low height.
Get on all fours with one foot under the bar.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching legs.

name: رومانيان ديدلفت بالزجاجة
description: A hip hinge holding a weighted bottle in each hand. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with light load.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bottles along your legs with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your shoulders back and your core braced.

name: رومانيان ديدلفت على ساق واحدة بالزجاجة
englishName: bottle weighted single leg romanian deadlift
description: A one-legged hip hinge holding weighted bottles. It works the hamstrings and glutes and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a bottle in each hand, with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bottles toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: أرجحة بالزجاجة
description: A hip-driven swing with a weighted bottle held in both hands. It trains the glutes and hamstrings explosively.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your hips, holding a bottle with both hands.
Hinge back and let the bottle swing between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bottle swing to chest height.
Keep your arms relaxed, the hips do the work.
Let it fall back and hinge into the next rep.

name: سكوات أمامي بالزجاجة
description: A squat holding weighted bottles at shoulder height. It works the quads and glutes and keeps your torso upright.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand at your shoulders, elbows pointing forward.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.

name: سكوات سومو بالزجاجة
description: A wide-stance squat holding a weighted bottle between your legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a bottle with both hands in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower your hips straight down.
Keep your knees pushing out over your toes.
Stop when your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.

name: سبليت سكوات بالزجاجة
description: A stationary lunge holding bottles at your sides. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

name: اندفاع أمامي بالزجاجة
description: A walking-style lunge stepping forward with bottles in your hands. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs each rep.

name: اندفاع خلفي بالزجاجة
description: A lunge stepping backward while holding bottles. It is easy on the knees and trains the glutes and quads.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and your chest up.
Push through the front heel to come back.
Alternate legs, or finish one side then switch.

name: ديدلفت بساقين مستقيمتين بالزجاجة
description: A near-straight-leg deadlift with bottles in your hands. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight, with a tiny knee bend.
Hinge forward, sliding the bottles down your legs.
Stop when you feel a firm hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

name: جسر الألوية بالزجاجة
description: A hip bridge with a weighted bottle resting on your hips. It isolates the glutes with light load.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a bottle across your hips with both hands.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: سكوات على الركبتين بالزجاجة
description: A squat from a kneeling position holding a bottle. It trains the glutes and hips without loading your feet.
instructions: Kneel on a mat with hips over knees, holding a bottle at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Pause lightly, keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward to return to upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

name: كرنش فوق الرأس بالزجاجة
description: A crunch with a bottle held overhead. The extra lever length makes your abs work harder.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead or keep them over your face.
Curl your ribs toward your hips and lift your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without dropping your head.

name: كرنش الضفدع بالزجاجة
description: A crunch that draws knees and chest together while holding a bottle. It trains the whole abdominal wall.
instructions: Lie on your back with soles together, knees open, holding a bottle on your chest.
Curl your upper body up as you pull your knees in.
Bring your chest toward your knees.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: ثني جانبي بالزجاجة
description: A standing side bend with a bottle in one hand. It strengthens the obliques.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a bottle in one hand at your side.
Place the other hand lightly behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the bottle without leaning forward.
Return to upright by squeezing your side.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: لف روسي بالزجاجة
description: A seated rotation holding a bottle. It works the obliques and deep core.
instructions: Sit on the floor, knees bent, and lean back a little with a straight spine.
Hold a bottle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the bottle near the floor.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your feet down or lifted for more challenge.

name: أمواج بالتناوب مع السكوات بالزجاجة
description: A squat with arms swinging like waves while holding bottles. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a bottle in each hand.
Squat down with your hips back.
As you stand, raise one arm up and the other down in a wave motion.
Switch arms on the next squat.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.

name: ضغط الصدر من الاستلقاء بالزجاجة
description: A floor or bench press with a bottle in each hand. It builds the chest and triceps with light load.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle in each hand at chest level.
Press the bottles straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep your wrists straight.
Lower slowly until your elbows touch the floor or reach chest level.
Repeat for your reps.

name: سفند برس بالزجاجة
description: A standing press with a bottle squeezed between your palms. It keeps constant tension on the chest.
instructions: Stand tall and press your palms together around a bottle at your chest.
Squeeze inward the whole time.
Push the bottle straight out in front of you.
Pause with your arms extended.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.

name: تجديف منحني بالزجاجة
description: A bent-over row with a bottle in each hand. It trains the mid back and lats.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bottles toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

name: بول أوفر بالزجاجة
description: A lying pullover with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the bottle in an arc behind your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your sides.
Pull it back over your chest.

name: فلاي عكسي منحني بالزجاجة
englishName: bottle weighted bent over reverse fly
description: A bent-over fly with bottles that targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand hanging below you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

name: تجديف الغوريلا بالزجاجة
description: Gorilla row using a weighted bottle in each hand, a handy way to train the back at home.
instructions: Stand wide with a bottle on the floor between your feet and hinge forward.
Keep your back flat and grip a bottle in each hand.
Row one bottle up to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it, then row with the other side.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides.

name: كونسنتريشن كيرل بالزجاجة
description: A seated one-arm curl with your elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps.
instructions: Sit with feet wide, a bottle in one hand, and rest your elbow on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang fully.
Curl the bottle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

name: كونسنتريشن كيرل بقبضة معكوسة بالزجاجة
englishName: bottle weighted reverse grip concentration curl
description: A seated concentration curl with an overhand grip. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Sit with feet wide, holding a bottle with an overhand grip, elbow resting on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang straight.
Curl the bottle up without bending your wrist.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

name: كيك باك بالزجاجة
description: A one-arm triceps kickback holding a bottle. It isolates the back of the arm.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor, bottle in hand.
Keep your elbow tight at your side.
Straighten your arm behind you.
Squeeze your triceps.
Bend slowly, then switch arms.

name: كيك باك بذراعين بالزجاجة
description: A triceps kickback done with both arms together using two bottles.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Extend both arms straight behind you.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.

name: تمدد الترايسبس فوق الرأس بالزجاجة
description: An overhead extension with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and strengthens the triceps.
instructions: Stand or sit tall holding a bottle overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Bend your elbows and lower the bottle behind your head.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.
Keep your upper arms still.

name: بايسبس كيرل بالتناوب بالزجاجة
description: Alternating curls with a bottle in each hand. It builds the biceps and keeps the pace easy.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms forward.
Curl one bottle toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly as you curl the other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Avoid swinging your torso.

name: هامر كيرل بالتناوب بالزجاجة
description: Alternating curls with palms facing in. It works the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms facing your body.
Curl one bottle up without rotating your wrist.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your elbows pinned.

name: ريفرس كيرل بالزجاجة
description: A curl with an overhand grip holding bottles. It trains the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand with palms facing down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bottles up with straight wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: سحب عمودي بالزجاجة
description: A vertical pull with bottles toward your chest. It works the shoulders and traps.
instructions: Stand tall holding bottles in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull them up along your body, elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height.
Lower slowly.
Keep the bottles close to your torso.

name: تجديف الإبط بالزجاجة
description: A high row pulling bottles up toward your armpits. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge slightly forward.
Pull your elbows out and up, bottles moving toward your armpits.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

name: رفع أمامي بالزجاجة
description: A front raise with bottles for the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: رفع جانبي بالزجاجة
description: A side raise with bottles that builds the shoulder caps.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

name: رفع أمامي بالتناوب بالزجاجة
description: Alternating front raises with a bottle in each hand. It works the front delts.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other.
Keep your torso still.
Breathe steadily.

name: ضغط الكتف بالزجاجة
description: An overhead press with a bottle in each hand. It builds shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Press both bottles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to shoulder height.
Do not arch your lower back.

name: هالو بالزجاجة
description: A circular movement of a bottle around your head. It warms up the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle at chest height with both hands.
Circle it around your head, staying close.
Keep your core braced and ribs down.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Reverse direction on the next set.

name: لمس أصابع القدم بالتناوب من الاستلقاء على الأرض
description: Lying on your back with legs raised, you reach up to touch your toes alternately. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs raised toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms up.
Crunch up and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Lower and reach with the other hand.
Keep your legs steady.

name: بلانك العنكبوت
description: A plank with alternating knee drives to the elbow, building core strength.
instructions: Start in a high or forearm plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides without letting your hips sag.

name: سحب البلانك الجانبي
description: A side plank with a pulling arm motion, to build core stability and shoulder strength.
instructions: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Reach your top arm overhead.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: رفع الساق الأمامية مع لمس الركبة من الأسفل
englishName: front leg lift under knee tap
description: A standing move where you drive a knee up and tap beneath it with your hands. It warms up the hips and works the abs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands out in front.
Lift one knee up and forward to hip height.
Reach both hands under that thigh and tap beneath the knee.
Lower the foot with control and switch legs.
Keep your chest up and stay light on your feet.
Alternate sides at a steady, bouncy pace.

name: لمس الركبة العالية
description: Fast knee-drive drill where you tap your knees to your hands, great for warming up and raising the heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall with hands out in front at waist height.
Drive one knee up to tap your hand.
Lower it and switch quickly to the other knee.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a fast, steady pace for time.

name: ركلة خلفية مع ضغط فوق الرأس
description: A dynamic combo of a backward leg kick with an overhead arm press. It works the shoulders and glutes together and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
Keep your core tight throughout.

name: ركلة خلفية مع ضغط فوق الرأس
description: A dynamic combo of a backward leg kick with an overhead arm press. It works the shoulders and glutes together and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
Keep your core tight throughout.

name: دوائر الساق السباحة
description: A lying leg circle drill with a swimming-style rhythm. It loosens the hips and trains the glutes and core control.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw small, controlled circles with that leg.
Reverse the direction after several circles.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips pressed down and your core braced.

name: دوائر الساق السباحة
description: A lying leg circle drill with a swimming-style rhythm. It loosens the hips and trains the glutes and core control.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw small, controlled circles with that leg.
Reverse the direction after several circles.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips pressed down and your core braced.

name: نط الحبل بوزن الجسم
description: Skipping without a rope, with light hops and big arm swings. It lifts your heart rate and warms up the legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step and hop on one foot while driving the opposite knee up.
Swing the opposite arm forward as you hop.
Switch sides in a rhythmic skip.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.

name: نط الحبل بوزن الجسم
description: Skipping without a rope, with light hops and big arm swings. It lifts your heart rate and warms up the legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step and hop on one foot while driving the opposite knee up.
Swing the opposite arm forward as you hop.
Switch sides in a rhythmic skip.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.

name: ركض بخطوات سريعة
description: Running on the spot with very fast, small steps. It's a classic warm-up and speed drill.
instructions: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Run on the spot as fast as you can with small steps.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms.
Keep your chest up.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

name: جاك نايف
description: A Pilates move where you lift your legs and trunk together to fold at the hips. It challenges the abs and balance.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Lift both legs up toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor and lift your hips slightly.
Raise your trunk and reach toward your toes.
Roll back down slowly with control.
Keep your movement smooth, without swinging.

name: ليج كيرل من الاستلقاء بوزن الجسم
description: A floor-based curl where you bend the knees against no added load. It targets the hamstrings in a simple way.
instructions: Lie on your front with your legs straight.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Bend your knees and bring your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower your feet slowly back to the floor.
Keep your hips pressed down throughout.

name: وضعية اليوغا بافانموكتاسانا
description: The wind-relieving pose, where you hug your knees to your chest while lying down. It stretches the hips and lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend your knees and draw them into your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins and hug them in.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and extend your legs.

name: وضعية اليوغا أردها ماتسيندراسانا
description: The half spinal twist, a seated yoga pose. It stretches the spine and outer hip and improves rotation.
instructions: Sit tall with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and place that foot outside the opposite thigh.
Hug the bent knee with the opposite arm.
Place your other hand behind you and twist toward it.
Lengthen the spine and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.

name: رفع لوح الكتف بذراع واحدة بالدمبل
description: A single-arm shrug-style movement that trains the muscles that lift and control the shoulder blade. It helps shoulder stability.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulder blade straight up toward your ear.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: تجديف لوح الكتف منحني بالدمبل
description: A bent-over movement where you pull the shoulder blades together with straight arms. It builds the mid-back muscles that stabilize the shoulders.
instructions: Hold dumbbells and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending the elbows.
Hold for a moment.
Release the blades and let the weights drop slightly.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

name: تجديف لوح الكتف واقفاً بوزن الجسم
description: A standing drill where you squeeze your shoulder blades together with no weight. It wakes up the mid back and helps posture.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out in front or at your sides.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Release slowly.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders to your ears.

name: وضعية اليوغا ناماسكاراسانا
description: A deep squatting pose with the palms pressed together in front of the chest. It opens the hips and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat.
Press your palms together at the chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Keep your chest lifted and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Stand up slowly.

name: لف مرونة السكوات
description: A deep squat paired with a trunk rotation. It opens the hips and upper back and improves rotation.
instructions: Lower into a deep squat with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one hand on the floor or inside your knee.
Rotate your chest and reach the other arm up toward the ceiling.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Return to the center and switch sides.
Keep your heels on the floor.

name: دوران خارجي جالساً بالدمبل
description: A seated rotator cuff exercise using a light dumbbell. It strengthens the small muscles that stabilize the shoulder.
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a light dumbbell.
Rest your elbow on your thigh or bent at your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: درايفر واقفاً بالدمبل
description: A standing dumbbell press that uses a drive from the legs and trunk. It builds shoulder strength and power.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower the weight to your shoulder.
Switch arms after your set.

name: أرنولد برس معكوس جالساً بالدمبل
description: The Arnold press performed in reverse, rotating the palms inward on the way down. It works all three heads of the shoulder.
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells overhead with your palms forward.
Lower the weights while rotating your palms toward you.
Stop with the dumbbells in front of your chest.
Rotate your palms back outward as you press up.
Lock out the arms overhead.
Keep your back against the pad.

name: رفع أمامي جالس بذراع واحدة بالدمبل
englishName: dumbbell seated single arm front raise
description: A seated front raise done one arm at a time. It targets the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Sit tall holding a dumbbell at your side.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid leaning back.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: كرنش بذراعين مستقيمتين بالدمبل v. 2
description: A crunch with your arms straight overhead holding a dumbbell. The load increases the demand on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with straight arms over your chest.
Curl your upper back off the floor, reaching up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

name: هايبر إكستنشن معكوس على المقعد بالدمبل
description: A bench-supported reverse hyper with a dumbbell held between your feet. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hold the bench for support.
Raise your legs until they align with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: تجديف منحني على الحائط بالدمبل
englishName: dumbbell bent over row against wall
description: A dumbbell row where you lean on a wall for support. It trains the back while sparing the lower back.
instructions: Stand a step from a wall and hinge forward.
Support your forehead or free hand on the wall.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging.
Row the weights toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

name: هامر كيرل صارم بالتناوب بالدمبل
description: An alternating hammer curl done with strict form, keeping your body still. It builds the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with your palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up without swinging.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your torso still.

name: تمدد الترايسبس فوق الرأس جالساً بالتناوب بالدمبل
englishName: dumbbell seated alternate overhead triceps extension
description: A seated overhead extension done one arm after the other. It isolates the triceps through a deep stretch.
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand overhead.
Lower one dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend the arm back up.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your core braced.

name: دراج كيرل جالساً بالدمبل
description: A curl where the elbows move back and the dumbbells drag up along your torso. It hits the biceps with less shoulder help.
instructions: Sit holding dumbbells with your palms forward.
Keep the weights close to your body.
Pull your elbows back as you curl.
Drag the dumbbells up along your torso.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

name: كونسنتريشن كيرل مزدوج جالساً بالدمبل
description: A concentration curl done with both arms at once, elbows braced on your thighs. It isolates the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet wide.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward.
Rest the backs of your upper arms on your inner thighs.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: بوش أب معكوس بالدمبل
description: A push-up variation performed with the hands on dumbbells in a reverse hand position. It focuses on the triceps.
instructions: Place two dumbbells on the floor and grip them.
Set up in a plank position.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Stop just above the floor.
Press back up to the start.
Keep your body in a straight line.

name: سنتش بذراع واحدة بالدمبل (اليسرى)
description: A single-arm snatch that takes a dumbbell from the floor to overhead in one motion. This version uses the left arm.
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip it with your left hand and hinge at the hips.
Drive up with your legs and hips.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body and punch it overhead.
Lock out the arm.
Lower the weight back to the floor with control.

name: تجديف منحني بالكيتل بيل
description: A bent-over row using a kettlebell. It trains the lats and mid back.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the kettlebell toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: تمدد الترايسبس فوق الرأس جالساً بذراع واحدة بالدمبل
englishName: dumbbell seated single arm overhead triceps extension
description: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in one hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
Keep your core braced.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: تمدد الترايسبس فوق الرأس جالساً بذراع واحدة بالدمبل (اليسرى)
englishName: dumbbell seated single arm overhead triceps extension (left)
description: A seated overhead triceps extension with one dumbbell. This version uses the left arm.
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in your left hand overhead.
